| This has been quite a past week. First, in a historic decision, the Supreme Court overruled Roe and Casey, righting a historic wrong and sending abortion back to the states and the representatives of the people. The language from Justice Alito’s opinion reads, “Held: The Constitution does not confer a right to abortion; Roe and Casey are overruled; and the authority to regulate abortion is returned to the people and their elected representatives." I was proud to join an amicus brief in Dobbs supporting Mississippi’s law to protect life, which led to this historic decision. As your next US Senator, I will continue to defend innocent life. You don’t have to take my word for it - just look at [my pro-life record](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=5aae9fe724&e=6dcd2506d1) as Arizona’s Attorney General. The Supreme Court made another important decision this week [upholding the Second Amendment](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=45c12b907c&e=6dcd2506d1) and striking down New York’s attempt to restrict concealed carry rights. We co-led that coalition to defend the Second Amendment before SCOTUS and this win reaffirms that our rights are God-given, not government granted.

And we [just got a ruling](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=09135eba6b&e=6dcd2506d1) protecting the First Amendment and freedom of expression! I was proud to co-lead the 27-state coalition amicus brief on this case, defending a High School football coach who prayed on the 50-yard line after games and was fired for it.
Finally, thank you to all who tuned in for the FreedomWorks Forum with my US Senate primary opponents. In that debate, you saw the difference between talk and action. While my opponents stood on stage and talked the talk — I was able to show [my record](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=1be0e150a8&e=6dcd2506d1). A record that has been fighting to secure our southern border, protecting children against CRT, and putting the people of Arizona first. If you missed it, watch [here](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=fdcfd8a81f&e=6dcd2506d1)!

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | This has been quite a past week. First, in a historic decision, the Supreme Court overruled Roe and Casey, righting a historic wrong and sending abortion back to the states and the representatives of the people. The language from Justice Alito’s opinion reads, “Held: The Constitution does not confer a right to abortion; Roe and Casey are overruled; and the authority to regulate abortion is returned to the people and their elected representatives." I was proud to join an amicus brief in Dobbs supporting Mississippi’s law to protect life, which led to this historic decision. As your next US Senator, I will continue to defend innocent life. You don’t have to take my word for it - just look at as Arizona’s Attorney General. The Supreme Court made another important decision this week and striking down New York’s attempt to restrict concealed carry rights. We co-led that coalition to defend the Second Amendment before SCOTUS and this win reaffirms that our rights are God-given, not government granted. And we protecting the First Amendment and freedom of expression! I was proud to co-lead the 27-state coalition amicus brief on this case, defending a High School football coach who prayed on the 50-yard line after games and was fired for it. Finally, thank you to all who tuned in for the FreedomWorks Forum with my US Senate primary opponents. In that debate, you saw the difference between talk and action. While my opponents stood on stage and talked the talk — I was able to show . A record that has been fighting to secure our southern border, protecting children against CRT, and putting the people of Arizona first. Friend, I’m so grateful you’re part of our people-powered movement to flip Arizona blue. But I have to be honest: I’m counting on your help now more than ever. I’m a proud Democrat, former border city mayor and Obama administration alum – and I’m running for governor to build a state that works for all our people. body:
| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15846?t=6&akid=3490%2E878179%2Eg6gJ70) Dear team,

The Supreme Court has ruled that reproductive health care is no longer federally protected and will now be decided by the individual states.

In Texas, Greg Abbott has already signed a “trigger law” that criminalizes all abortion — with no exception for rape or incest — and goes into effect 30 days following Friday’s decision.

That means that in a matter of weeks, no woman will have control over her body in Texas, a state that already struggles to ensure proper medical care for women and girls and which leads much of the developed world in the rate of maternal mortality. More women face this unprecedented attack on their freedom and their health in Texas than in any other state in America.

So it’s on us to respond and to act. That means standing up to Abbott and fighting for Texas women by winning this election for governor.

Imagine the impact that will have not only in Texas, but across the country.

The state that came up with this “trigger law,” the state that has been leading the attack on a woman’s right to choose for over a decade, and the state that promised bounty hunters $10,000 to turn in those who helped women get an abortion can be the state that elects a governor who will work to ensure that every woman makes her own decisions about her own body and her own future.

Let’s use these next days — between Friday’s decision and the implementation of Abbott’s total abortion ban — to assemble the volunteers and raise the resources we need to win political power. Do not succumb to the temptation to despair or give up in the face of this attack. Turn your anger into action and focus on what will do the greatest good.

The only way to overcome this attack on women and reproductive freedom is to win this election.

The only way to win this election is with your help.

Peter, that’s me you’re looking at.

It was 1976. I was in my senior year at Fort Hamilton High School in Brooklyn, and I was scrambling to figure out what direction I wanted my career to go in. I knew that I was lucky to even have the opportunity to decide what I wanted to do next. So many people from my school didn’t have that luxury.
But every time I thought about what career I wanted to pursue, I kept coming back to the civil rights marches and protests that I encountered when I was younger. The Civil Rights Movement consumed the better part of my childhood, and it instilled a fiery passion for justice and equality in me from a young age.

As a child, I loved to read. I remember getting lost in the stacks and picking up a book on Justice Thurgood Marshall. It was then, inspired by his story, that I first began to toy with the idea of law school – at a time when so few lawyers were Black or female, let alone both. I knew that having a law degree would be a valuable tool in the fight for justice and equality, so I decided to pursue law school despite the high barriers to entry.
**Back then, I didn’t know that my fight for justice and my interest in law would take me to elected office – and I definitely never pictured myself becoming attorney general of New York. All I knew was that I wanted to help families like my own,_and that’s exactly what I’ve done. _**
Peter, I’ve spent every moment as attorney general fighting to protect the voiceless and vulnerable – but I need your help to continue my work. **I’m up for re-election this November, and I have to defeat my Republican opponent to continue to fight as your attorney general for another four years, so please: **

#
Friend of Life,

This is one of the most surreal moments I've ever experienced.

After decades of marching, advocating, and praying, Roe v. Wade is finally finished, the false "constitutional right" to kill a preborn child has been erased by the United States Supreme Court.

We are experiencing a truly historic victory for life!

I rejoice alongside you for the lives that will be saved due to the reversal of this horrific decision. However, this victory is just the beginning.

Our work to transform our culture and make abortion unthinkable is just getting started.

Abortion advocates are in an uproar, pushing lies that women will die, life-saving medical care will be eliminated, and the reversal of Roe will lead us back to the "Dark Ages."

Remember, abortion is still legal and even subsidized in many states. The killing of preborn babies has not stopped.

We are now fighting an uphill battle against an onslaught of disinformation and deceit -- the same lies that led to the senseless killing of 63 million innocent children.

The pro-life movement is facing its most critical moment in history.

In order to keep up our momentum for life, we need your financial support.

Specifically, I am looking for 50 people who want to protect babies from abortion to step forward and make a $30 gift before midnight tonight. This will enable us to reach 50,000 moms and dads with the truth they need to choose life. Donate here:**[https://give.liveaction.org](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60401481:s-OufAhkN:m:1:2532013465:01A5C0B84F1564AE014002BA2968AA94:r)**

There is no doubt about it: the goal of the abortion lobby is to enshrine the "right" to kill a child through abortion in federal law. Now that they have failed in the Supreme Court, we will see more efforts than ever before to pass a national law forcing abortion on every community.

Pro-abortion activists are hoping we call it victory and walk away from the fight. But we will not make that mistake.

We must ensure that pro-life states, like Oklahoma, Mississippi, Texas, and dozens of others can continue to enact laws protecting preborn babies. We must shut down abortion facilities that are endangering the lives of women and putting to death innocent children--and we must continue the groundwork to build a Culture of Life in states like California, New York, and Illinois where abortion-on-demand is the law of the land.

No one has the right to intentionally kill an innocent human being. Our human rights, the first among them the right to life, are inherent and given to us by God. Governments exist to protect those rights.

Please stand with us to build a culture that cherishes every human life, starting with our precious preborn children. Make your gift right now to ensure that abortion dies with Roe: **[https://give.liveaction.org](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60401481:s-OufAhkN:m:1:2532013465:01A5C0B84F1564AE014002BA2968AA94:r)**

People can change, and they change their hearts and minds when they are presented with the true humanity of the preborn child and the horrfic violence of abortion. And no other pro-life organization reaches as many people online with the truth about the killing of preborn children.

Your gift of $30 today will get the truth in front 1,000 young women and men who are hearing nothing but lies about abortion from the media. You can be a catalyst for change now: **[https://give.liveaction.org](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60401481:s-OufAhkN:m:1:2532013465:01A5C0B84F1564AE014002BA2968AA94:r)**

We have reversed a deadly decision that has killed over 63 million innocent children, but we are just getting started in our battle to protect the lives of babies for generations to come. The Court can only change laws, it's up to us to change hearts and minds.

Thank you so much for your generosity that can make the end of Roe lead to the end of abortion.

For life,

**Lila Rose**
Founder and President

subject: GREATER GEORGIA TO HOLD 4TH OF JULY REGISTRATION EVENTS AT ATLANTA AREA GROCERY STORES
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Greater Georgia Action, Inc
body:
---
| | | | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, JUNE 28
GREATER GEORGIA TO HOLD 4TH OF JULY REGISTRATION EVENTS AT ATLANTA AREA GROCERY STORES (ATLANTA) - This Wednesday through Friday, Greater Georgia is holding its latest series of voter registration events at Atlanta-area grocery stores, where shoppers are facing record high prices heading into the July 4th holiday thanks to spiking inflation driven by Washington's failed policies. New voters will have the opportunity to register at stores in Fulton and DeKalb counties, and these efforts build on Greater Georgia's earlier consumer registration efforts at [gas stations](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010qrKy6dDyE9T8IBeyMG_Nd6HOLxGJ0kqZyDTh5jYzPGmJAUnc9m3JWhThUOAoJj6PErPF54cQTcup3yrfyaSLA98048u4ipKOQcaL8Zw0Gl8OGThq49Wg_CX4p0tuOvdpc0lKkoP7t8f345Kjb6JY3LsZ9_6KZHFugFiTwOJMwoZuVOaNTdi1lc_Mrx0a1-NHwaS_b7m1spoQIeAERSxe6_rcmnSlf1OKsxZ2PWVBfJEKDnna_eB4yucdKkWDkPhXnfEx0agz5s=&c=1Zpi5z3oGMzBMTxnNWUIPhTRxPumvYkJkNNicBtynLZ4UrpE3QR-2A==&ch=VVW0XxQQjf84wBaMDPgm8Jzb7Rwpl7O-TUPut0bWMuhq9XGiVvBj_Q==) and [gun stores](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010qrKy6dDyE9T8IBeyMG_Nd6HOLxGJ0kqZyDTh5jYzPGmJAUnc9m3JTOWQD5tmOqpqwDEVuHhW1zYoauUQ6g0Xj3-Eq0eUdGKt2ZWq9q2VmL669g6bQnaM_pZ_Dt69sqm5nzfAbPEWiJShabSjZmhQizAED5HLny9XTBkEDF_yhTjIdHDubRe9Yozq_cHyd3Yj5c52d0_gWAWot6xWj0fRE1F9fyWADdaq_d_ZhEtCBjXv-OrmCYJnnoHNwxrKBKf&c=1Zpi5z3oGMzBMTxnNWUIPhTRxPumvYkJkNNicBtynLZ4UrpE3QR-2A==&ch=VVW0XxQQjf84wBaMDPgm8Jzb7Rwpl7O-TUPut0bWMuhq9XGiVvBj_Q==). By registering Georgians at the point of sale, Greater Georgia is encouraging consumers to take action in the upcoming November general election. "Thanks to the tax-and-spend, Green New Deal agenda of Washington bureaucrats, economists estimate that Georgia's families will pay an extra $7,200 on purchases in 2022 - and next week, they'll be paying for one of the most expensive 4th of July holidays ever recorded," said former U.S. Senator and Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "By meeting voters where they're hurting most, Greater Georgia is mobilizing them to take action and help put a stop to the inflation that's draining their pocketbooks. By registering voters, mobilizing them, and encouraging them to support conservatives in the upcoming November election, we are growing the tent - and making Georgians' voices heard."

* American cookouts are expected to cost at least 17% more compared to last year. body:
Peter —
Our next fundraising deadline is at midnight on July 1st — the SAME DAY that DeSantis’ 15 week abortion ban takes effect in Florida, cutting off Florida women from critical, life-saving reproductive care, even in cases of rape, incest, or human trafficking.
And now that Roe v. Wade has been overturned, the fight for reproductive rights in Florida is the MOST IMPORTANT issue in the 2022 election.
That’s why I’m making the biggest ask I’ve ever made in this campaign. I’m asking for your help to raise $73,000 DOLLARS before midnight on July 1st so we can protect the rights women and girls have had since 1973.
Will you chip in $20 (or whatever you can) to help us meet our goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-roe-73k?refcode=628email_1]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately.

Let’s be clear — without Roe v. Wade and federal protection for abortion rights, DeSantis and his GOP allies aren’t going to stop at 15 weeks. They’re going to pass a FULL abortion ban in Florida.
But I promise you this: when I’m elected Governor, I will veto ANY bill limiting women’s rights, restricting reproductive freedom, or taking away abortion rights.
The only way we’re going to protect abortion rights in Florida is by electing a candidate who’s always fought for reproductive freedom. So, if you’re with me, I’m personally asking you to chip in $20 to help us hit our goal and win the fight for abortion rights. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-roe-73k?refcode=628email_1]
Thank you for your support.
— Nikki

Team,

Every day is an important day for our campaign, but some days are make or break. June 30th is one of those days. 6/30 is a critical Federal Election Committee filing deadline, where candidates are required to disclose how much money they have raised in the past quarter. name: Joe Kent
subject: Bad News, Worse News
body:
Dear Peter,
My campaign against Jaime Herrera Beutler is entering the final stages and the reporting deadline is just a few days away.
Will you make an emergency contribution today to please help me meet our budget? Please contribute at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Y7Oge4DcWOPalUJip763Nz5w/FJbTOXgtg6Lx4XQF1nDRNw).
So first, the bad news.
It's unlikely that I will raise more money than Jaime this quarter. Because she voted to impeach President Trump, voted to fund Planned Parenthood with tax dollars, voted for red flag laws, and stands with the corporate elite on every issue, the Establishment rewards her with millions of dollars in campaign contributions.
Now here's the worse news: dark money groups have even more millions lined up to flood the airwaves of our district to try to buy her re-election. Big pharma, the Koch family, and extreme environmental groups are going to stop at nothing to re-elect her.
Will you help me level the playing field by making an end-of-quarter contribution at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Y7Oge4DcWOPalUJip763Nz5w/FJbTOXgtg6Lx4XQF1nDRNw)?
The ruling elite don't support Jaime because they actually like her. They support her because they fear me and what I stand for. An unapologetic supporter of President Trump and a fighter for the America First cause is their worst nightmare.
So please -- in these final moments of the quarter and just a couple of weeks before the voting starts, send whatever you can afford at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Y7Oge4DcWOPalUJip763Nz5w/FJbTOXgtg6Lx4XQF1nDRNw).
I've given this race everything I have. I've put in nearly $300,000 of my own money that I earned during a 20 year military career. I've done three-hundred events, driven thousands of miles, and have flown all over the country in search of the resources I need to fight the tide of establishment's money and influence.
And I promise I won't let up not for even a minute until the election is decided. I'm going to end this campaign either with my shield or on it.
Thank you,

Joe Kent
PS: Anything helps. [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Y7Oge4DcWOPalUJip763Nz5w/FJbTOXgtg6Lx4XQF1nDRNw).

Friend, tomorrow voters will make their voices heard and choose the Republican candidate for Colorado’s 8th District. Can you help us?

name: Charity Barry
subject: Roe v. Wade Overturned But The Fight Has Only Begun
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
---|---
|
Fellow Conservative:

June 24, 2022 will go down in American History as a day where the Supreme Court of the United States righted a wrong that unfortunately plagued our great nation for far too long! The highest court in our nation overturned Roe v. Wade, signaling the end of the federal government's hold on abortion, the abhorrent practice of ending a life before it has begun.

I have only been a candidate for public office for a year; however, I have been a stalwart standing for life since I was a child. The Right to Life is the bedrock of Western Civilization and the fundamental right on which our nation was founded. Every person has the right to pursue their dreams and aspirations - Every single person, born and unborn.

I am asking that you stand with me as I stand for you in Washington. I am asking you to stand with the millions of children who will be born now that Roe's terror upon our nation is over. Let us continue to give a voice to the voiceless.

Recently, Matt Sande, Legislative Director/Deputy State Director of Pro-Life Wisconsin publicly announced Pro Life Wisconsin's endorsement of my candidacy for the 2nd Congressional District! I am both proud and honored to receive this endorsement.

I cannot stand for you in Washington without your help. I need to get there first! I need your help. Donating to my candidacy goes to unseating Mark Pocan, a representative who does not value life and agrees with "on demand" abortion up until birth. Every penny will go towards that effort. I will not rest until Mark Pocan is no longer representing this district or Wisconsin.

Peter,
There are no words that will remedy this situation. Millions of women and birthing people across Tennessee and our country had their rights stripped away by an unjust and politically motivated Supreme Court. To add insult to injury, Bill Lee rejoiced this immoral ruling. There's no grace for eptopic pregnancies, rape, incest, or health of the mother.
This is a clear attack on women, simply put; this is about control.
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/martinlaunch]
When elected I will repeal this trigger law that bans abortion in Tennessee. I also will make it a priority to approve legislation that will expand Medicaid and ensure that we are able to provide those medical services again here in the state. Until Lee's trigger law is repealed, we need to make sure that any legislation we pass includes coverage for transportation, protections against prosecution, increased counseling services, and a renewed focus on the people affected most. When elected, I will not hesitate to use the pardoning power of the office to make sure that no health care provider is prosecuted for providing needed services. If the radical super majority in the General Assembly decides to move forward and prosecute women, I will ensure that any woman seeking an abortion is pardoned if prosecutors choose to attack our citizens in their time of need.
Democracy, liberty, and bodily autonomy cannot be revoked. Please, will you consider donating to our campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/martinlaunch]
We cannot sit idly by while the far-right takes everything from us.
Thank you,
Dr. Jason Martin

body:
Derek, the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade has made it clear what’s at stake in this election.
The future of abortion access in Pennsylvania will be decided by the winner of this Governor’s race.
My opponent, Doug Mastriano, says banning abortion outright is his “number one priority.”
Let’s be clear about what that means: He’s saying there should be zero exceptions for rape, incest, or if life of the mother is at risk. He even said that if he was elected Governor, he’d make abortion a crime and throw doctors in jail for performing them.
Now that the right to choose is up to the states, Mastriano could actually make all that happen if he wins this competitive election.
But that kind of dangerous extremism is why I’m so grateful this team is working day and night to win this race, stop Mastriano from gaining the power to enact that ban, and most importantly defend abortion access in Pennsylvania. I cannot win this race alone — and that’s why I’m coming to you right now.

---
Diner Stop Tour
---
This week, Tim hit the road for a diner stop tour in Lakewood, Broomfield and Golden. Thank you to all who joined us! It was great meeting everyone and chatting about what's important to you this election.
---
---
---
North Metro Conservative Gathering
---
Tim and Team Reichert had a great time chatting with voters after the North Metro Conservative gathering. We had great conversations about the need to restore energy independence, concerns that our education system isn't prepare our children for successful futures, inflation raising prices and making it harder to make ends meet, and the importance of sending an economist to Congress.
---
---
Jeffco Eats
---
Thank you to Barbara Moore and the Jeffco Eats team for providing food to those in our community who are struggling. Tim joined the Jeffco Eats team to put together meals for the community, along with the Kiwanis Club and other volunteers.
---
---
---
Main Street Business Tour
---
Tim hit the road yesterday to meet with small businesses in the district and discuss how much harm increased costs due to inflation are harming small businesses. Tim's [Handshake with the Middle Class](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0015tN8jprMQffiDFosPYRbA8TqMwcyP3AI0GcaipQM619aQ8opugKsHgMu2JQiVOL1ZZG2cc5Z4xRWdX2wM_DBE846ThNxIBgijZxM0oEFzm3S_vHaIgEKKmzQy0pS7u7XFs9sQXcOi5e2dJm4_GZYNzo1ETSodOznwNJlzEpRGgFHTS6cbtGvG6fYKYcLLyA-ZJyR3Dt6WLO8IdWw85y8k5R4oObccVRo1rCNqAtaWAwrZiT5lHvwpf-J8-0EGfTE&c=D52OW6YWFwNsyzQh-OpSECthHPIcwdArOr7B3TiVb5COm0M4XXbh4w==&ch=CnKY7v8Zkg1VHfE1YelohHB-CWA15UTsEDxzS30s90qCkCxSKqr3uw==) includes several policies meant to aide small business owners.
---
---
Women for Reichert
---
Tim met for lunch members of the Women for Reichert Coalition to discuss the importance of driving down the cost of gas and groceries so families can flourish.

Thank you to all who joined us! It was great meeting everyone and chatting about what's important to you this election. North Metro Conservative Gathering Tim and Team Reichert had a great time chatting with voters after the North Metro Conservative gathering. We had great conversations about the need to restore energy independence, concerns that our education system isn't prepare our children for successful futures, inflation raising prices and making it harder to make ends meet, and the importance of sending an economist to Congress. Jeffco Eats Thank you to Barbara Moore and the Jeffco Eats team for providing food to those in our community who are struggling. Tim joined the Jeffco Eats team to put together meals for the community, along with the Kiwanis Club and other volunteers. Main Street Business Tour Tim hit the road yesterday to meet with small businesses in the district and discuss how much harm increased costs due to inflation are harming small businesses. ---
| Dear Friend,
We are a nation of immigrants. But, we are also a nation founded on the rule of law. That's why I think it is so terrible that the Legislature is moving rapidly to make Massachusetts a sanctuary state.
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oMraaMXLWAI5-FwMELvE353W_vxF7cKUKu6sesI1gBXw8XIthh3Qda-wteooVFrhMhAzwl80J92X9HLLcmzSnJC0dHNk_bEREn6405Uvu981C_kNKYcUKpOqPpF4arubYgg0lkqu3m1kGpuGdYc5WErwHO0qWjHW&c=gYeV7CiPCUK85aA1DeUs4YOuUomvpfag1B-AOhNjUPsmGcKqBnP5yA==&ch=b6f5bN7lAZPAq_W6SCe4vQMakDPuugNLuE-ss_eRsYDhZPtwCkQzwQ==)
---
---
| A few weeks ago, the Legislature passed a bill to give driver's licenses to illegal immigrants. Now, those same legislators are preparing to take a vote on the so-called Safe Communities Act, which would prevent information sharing between state and federal officials.
I asked my good friend, Maureen Maloney, to chair a campaign for a ballot question to repeal the driver's license bill. I whole-heartedly support those efforts, which are now underway. But, in order to get on the ballot, the group will need to collect tens of thousands of signatures from voters over the next few weeks. I need your help to make sure this question makes the ballot so we can repeal the law.
It's clear legislators are intent on making Massachusetts a sanctuary state for illegal immigrants. This is wrong on so many levels, including the fact that it is offensive to the many lawful immigrants who came to our state legally, following all the rules to become a citizen of our country. It is important for us to oppose these legislators, starting with the repeal of the driver's license bill.
Will you help collect signatures to repeal the driver's license bill? If you haven't already signed up, please provide us with your information by using the link below.
---
| [Sign Up Now!](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oMraaMXLWAI5-FwMELvE353W_vxF7cKUKu6sesI1gBXw8XIthh3Qda-wteooVFrhMhAzwl80J92X9HLLcmzSnJC0dHNk_bEREn6405Uvu981C_kNKYcUKpOqPpF4arubYgg0lkqu3m1kGpuGdYc5WErwHO0qWjHW&c=gYeV7CiPCUK85aA1DeUs4YOuUomvpfag1B-AOhNjUPsmGcKqBnP5yA==&ch=b6f5bN7lAZPAq_W6SCe4vQMakDPuugNLuE-ss_eRsYDhZPtwCkQzwQ==)

| It's a big challenge, but not an insurmountable task. Just remember -- back in 2014, we collected more than 100,000 signatures from voters to tank the gas tax.
We did it before and we're going to do it again.
---
| Thanks for your support!

body:
Dear Friend,

It's official: The U.S. Supreme Court is broken.

The court has been stripping us of our civil liberties for weeks. It has completely eroded separation of church and state with a Maine case that allows public funds to support religious schools. It gutted Miranda rights, and expanded gun rights when it struck down a New York law that restricted concealed-carry — and at a moment when Americans are being terrorized by gun violence!

Yesterday, the court took away the full agency of women — and everyone who can become pregnant — in more than half the states in the country, relegating them to second-class citizens. In their dissent, Justices Stephen Breyer, Sonia Sotomayor, and Elena Kagan wrote: "from the very moment of fertilization, a woman has no rights to speak of." That's hard to process.

Basically six unelected, life-time appointed people have put their ideological beliefs before the Constitution and humanity. This Supreme Court is fundamentally broken and it needs to change!

What is happening is horrific and we need to be screaming from every street corner and rooftop, demanding change.

Let's take to the streets and mobilize the progressive vote in November. We will not be held hostage by a group of zealots intent on stripping us of our human rights and destroying our democracy. Join us today.

Fellow American,

We disrupted the status quo and defied conventional wisdom when we won our election last year and I became Virginia’s first Black female Lieutenant Governor – and even more so that I did it as a Republican!

By doing so, I put a target on my back – particularly one that the radical Left has in their sights.

I launched Winsome PAC this quarter to continue building the conservative grassroots movement we started and to push forward in our fight to restore common sense leadership in Virginia and America.

But because I am now a target, I am under immense scrutiny. How Winsome PAC performs this first quarter will be watched and observed by allies and opponents alike, and it’s critical that we show we’re a force to be reckoned with.

We’ve set an ambitious fundraising goal for this first quarter, and as we approach June 30th, we must make sure we’re on track to reach this goal.

Right now, we’re off the pace, and I need your help to ramp things up. [**As we approach our first End-of-Quarter deadline at MIDNIGHT THURSDAY, will you step up and chip in $10, $25, $50 or even $100 or more to help us get on track to hit our first quarterly target?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zag63bna7l83dtvofj1pghp54b4rce9bflvf43n8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5j6aor0c3h2bs)

The Ohio Democratic Party officially requested any documents pertaining to Majewski from the FBI.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47094541/353043789/1661460912?refcode=EM_FR_220628EOQ4_N_K4C_90DO_7_G_N_TESTB_logo_&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MmQxNWVkYS0wNWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Yqgj86NFm5bKTD0X1aAws99c33TLcnyg7YTe1euyIU=) This is big. Majewski has claimed for months that the FBI cleared him of criminal or seditious activity. We could take his word for it, but we **probably shouldn’t.** [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47094557/353043801/1661460912?refcode=EM_FR_220628EOQ4_N_K4C_90DO_7_G_N_TESTB_G1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MmQxNWVkYS0wNWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Yqgj86NFm5bKTD0X1aAws99c33TLcnyg7YTe1euyIU=) Since taking this guy at his word is a **_genuinely bad idea_ ,** the Ohio Democratic Party has sent a formal request to the FBI, asking for any and all non-classified documents regarding their investigation into Majewski’s actions on January 6, 2021. I sent out an email on Thursday that raised $145. Either Google is sending my emails to spam or our support is drying up. If things don't turn around, We quite literally ran toward a terrorist armed with cans of gasoline on a suicide mission. | [](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=4c0d1fc819e94be5b210e62f90d67bf6&_e=ts5h2o4HdzCgHNmNwMakWWARLNaj95OLx6OifxmT9CIqrevP8f7v54ed1EPtfo80L6M1A__3DdKGUHVUYHSItA4o3Yspkt-KPCNmKrQpni8JQVKZcUVpCdnYPOQvaAy0231yZAOkMJHKILGNAOhAWEtIRy3btBVSV1MW88AEuLHUnCZjYTg2eV978YOB12S3Vhru7ImKp3kCajBC8tWzO2gNfmnkPPhy2rSF75lcZwsbu10xfvI2VP7Ay04lbwOvFYWYrUf5iTH6-NqFbAPpXMCBWMgo4PpVc8-uhjw1zHNQ9SvVSQ39AGFvrNZVd3WTch-fViD9xqKbEE-klMVfJPjp4eYk16posZ4IVUlZ9A_Gw8Il_6fD5A92rLzTmpRj2dUQyy5hHkL14i8Av8Sje_mNUpUjGUflfn_QqAd7zMKOFzJ-sSwqPtQZRkXAKf6go1uWl5_ZsBfzYsL8oiww0g%3D%3D)
---

Peter,

**Is Google sending my emails to your spam folder again?** Last Thursday I sent out my first end of quarter fundraising ask and it brought in just **$146**.

**That is not going to cut it**. If we’re to win back the House in November, you have to step up and help fund targeted races like mine in Oregon. God knows that the Democrats are coming to the aid of my opponent.**Last month, she raised more than $50,000 online, nearly outraising my own campaign.**

Already today I’ve received two emails from her campaign trying to raise as much money as possible off of the decision the Supreme Court handed down last week.

name: Morton Blackwell
subject: Passing along this URGENT request from young conservatives
body:
I just received an urgent request from my staff on behalf of 50 young conservatives. I’ve forwarded it to you below.
|
---
| | | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63167%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=y2YVudMZFSPXratPxPA6%2bw&sysid=1) Fellow Conservative, I just received an urgent request from my staff on behalf of 50 young conservatives. I’ve forwarded it to you below. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training program is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. My staffer Bryan, who oversees the Leadership Institute’s campus programs, sent an urgent email to let me know **the demand by students to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63168%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JAjxHK3kGN9bE18%2fNXEr9g&sysid=1) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63169%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sKH9DDC9WuuHHchQ%2bi2l4A&sysid=1) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute
* * *
**From:** Bryan Bernys
**To:** Morton Blackwell
**Subject:** URGENT: Do we have any more scholarships? Morton, I just got confirmation that we can move the National Youth Leadership School to the university auditorium. That takes care of the classroom space issues we had. But now there’s a financial issue. With the increase in travel costs, we’ve used up everything in the scholarship fund for students’ travel and hotel rooms. My team still have **50 more applications** to process from students who want to come to the training. Is there any room left in the budget for more student travel scholarships? I don’t want to have to tell my team to turn students away who can’t afford to come, but there’s no other option if we can’t get more scholarship funding. Please let me know how to proceed as soon as possible. Respectfully, Bryan \--
**Bryan Bernys**
Vice President for the Campus Leadership Program
Leadership Institute
---
| | The Leadership Institute 1101 N. Highland St. Steven P.J. Wood Building Arlington VA 22201 United States
---

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: what is wrong with Washington
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Right now, I am angry, Peter.
| | |
---
As a nurse, I've been trained to care, to listen, to problem solve – not to lead with anger or emotion. **But right now, I am angry, Peter.**
Just a few days ago, extremists on the Supreme Court overturned nearly 50 years of precedent and stripped away abortion rights for millions of Americans. **This decision is the direct consequence of partisans in Washington using dishonesty and lies to grab power.**
You see, Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh, and Amy Coney Barrett swore to tell the truth to the Senate, and _under that oath,_ they said they believed Roe was settled precedent.
Then these very same justices stripped away millions of people’s right to choose and their right to determine their own future. **It is clear that they misled the Senate and the American public for the sole purpose of receiving a lifelong appointment to the highest court in our country.**
You can see so much of what is wrong with Washington in this decision – the dishonesty, the partisanship, and the disrespect. The court's actions infuriate me – but they also motivate me to do everything within my power to undo this terrible ruling.
**You have my word that as senator, I will always defend abortion access and the right to choose. I will lead with honesty and tell you the truth. I will put people before politics every time.**
I know that Missouri is ready for that kind of leader, but I cannot win without a strong base of grassroots support. **[That's why I'm reaching out to you: Please will you pitch in $5 right now to send compassion, honesty, and integrity to Washington?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47096153/353048931/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk106-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MjUyNWU2ZC0wYmY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zNssRHzDmuHMyRVbRiulNnYUvqpNGogIAslcLXMRwu8=)**
Together, I know that we can win a brighter, more equal future.

Warmly,

Trudy

name: Alessandra Biaggi
subject: The worst part about running for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress
body:
I'll be perfectly clear
#

Friends -
This Thursday at midnight we close the books on our first official FEC fundraising deadline since launching our campaign in New York's 17th district.
Let me tell you: The worst part about running for Congress is the obscene amount of money it takes to run a winning campaign.
It's part of the reason why people like my opponent happily take massive checks from corporate PACs, Wall Street banks, and big insurance companies — it's easy.
I'll be perfectly clear: That's not how we're running this campaign. Not now, not ever.
The only way we fund our movement is together, with lots and lots of people making grassroots contributions and chipping in what they can.
For that reason, we have some pretty ambitious fundraising goals we need to reach before this deadline ends. **And we need as many individual donations as we possibly can between now and then to get there.**
These next two days are two of the most important of this entire campaign, so I have to ask:
[**Can I count on you to make a $3 contribution to our campaign before this Thursday's official FEC fundraising deadline? This is a critical moment for our campaign, so please, add your donation today if you can.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biaggi-em-june/?refcode=em220628-1-subs&refcode2=864_59515_NCHXY7&akid=864%2E59515%2ENCHXY7)

subject: What is our purpose?
body:
One of the chief aims of education at Hillsdale College is to understand what kind of being we are, as well as our purpose. That, in turn, makes it possible to begin to understand our relationship to God.
[Unsubscribe](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osYYtXAhnN)

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60402627:sYYtXAhnN:m:1:2532013465:6D408084AF6EDD4A7FF1A4A16CBC0C20:r) Dear Fellow American,
I hope your day is going well. I'm writing to let you know about something I think you'll find useful in your learning.
Reason and speech are gifts from God that enable us to think about God and to worship Him. [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60402627:sYYtXAhnN:m:1:2532013465:6D408084AF6EDD4A7FF1A4A16CBC0C20:r) One of the chief aims of education at Hillsdale College is to understand what kind of being we are, as well as our purpose. That, in turn, makes it possible to begin to understand our relationship to God.

The study of God, also known as "theology," has had a profound impact on Western civilization, stretching back thousands of years to the ancient Hebrews. And that's what Hillsdale's **" Theology 101" **online course is about--the development of theology from the Old Testament through the twentieth century.

**" Theology 101"** has been a popular course, so I'm pleased to let you know that it is [**now available for you to own on DVD**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60402627:sYYtXAhnN:m:1:2532013465:6D408084AF6EDD4A7FF1A4A16CBC0C20:r). You can add it to your home library or give it as a gift to a friend or relative.
We do have a limited number of sets in stock, though--and they go fast--so don't delay in getting your copy of **" Theology 101"** on DVD. Secure yours right now at: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/support-hillsdales-online-courses-theology-101-dvd](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60402627:sYYtXAhnN:m:1:2532013465:6D408084AF6EDD4A7FF1A4A16CBC0C20:r)**
Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

Hillsdale College

| Trump has been rallying his supporters all over the country with his MAGA candidates to get Republican voters energized ahead of the midterm elections.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=372%2E5257348%2EufJP62)
Derek,
In case you haven’t heard, Trump has been rallying his supporters all over the country with his MAGA candidates to get Republican voters energized ahead of the midterm elections. That’s not the only reason why he’s touring the nation, though — we all know he _never_ acts without himself in mind first and foremost.
He’s doing this to help promote his eventual presidential campaign and to make sure the GOP continues to follow his every command even when he’s not holding public office.
Sadly, he is still the dominant voice in the GOP. Republican candidates are practically stepping over each other in order to prove themselves as _“MAGA enough”_ to earn Trump’s endorsement.
They’re willing to do anything and everything to get his attention and seal of approval. Republican candidates this year are more extreme than ever before and have no shame in continuing to peddle conspiracy theories about vaccines and the Big Lie.
_Trump’s efforts are all about helping himself, inflaming the country, and building up his campaign coffers and chits._
It’s clear: Trump is working to create the most right-wing Congress, court system, and state governments in history. With that, they can be used to deliver him the presidency even if he loses.
We can’t let Trump’s cult of personality gain further control over our democracy. **[Pitch in $10 or any amount before our crucial FEC deadline in 48 hours to help us defend our majorities in Congress and stop Trump from rising to power again.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jun2022_abs_em.pEwDN5&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20220628_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=372%2E5257348%2EufJP62)**

name: Team Lizzie
subject: #TeamLizzie Weekly Update – 19 weeks to Election Day!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220628wu?refcode=lpfe220628wu_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220628wu?refcode=lpfe220628wu_m]
This week has been an eventful one. As you know, the Supreme Court handed down its final decision in Dobbs v. Jackson , overturning Roe v. Wade . We’ve known this decision was likely for some time now, but it doesn’t lessen the sting of our new reality. Many Americans haven’t known a world without Roe until now, and the majority of Americans didn’t want it to be overturned. This decision goes against the will of the people. Instead, it’s the result of decades of anti-choice extremists and politicians’ chipping away at our reproductive rights.
This isn’t the end though. With Lizzie in office, we know we have leaders in our corner fighting for our values — including reproductive freedom. Lizzie voted to make Roe law in all 50 states and she’s working to protect access to reproductive care for Texans and Americans everywhere. She’s going to continue that fight for as long as it takes to restore our most fundamental rights.
And right now, the way to do that is to win elections. There is simply no other way to protect, and in states like ours restore, these fundamental rights than to elect people who will do so. We need a pro-choice majority in Congress and in state houses across the country.
Reproductive rights are on the ballot in November, and this team is going to do everything we can to elect pro-choice champions. We have 19 weeks to go.
Progress Made
We did have good news on Friday: The House and Senate passed our country’s first gun-safety reforms in a decade, and now, President Biden has signed them into law.
After Uvalde and so many other mass shootings that have devastated our communities, and the daily gun violence that affects people across the country, action on gun violence was overdue. While there is still much work to do to make our communities safer from gun violence, this is an important moment. And it was the result of so many people working together to advocate for change, including so many on #TeamLizzie.
Eyes on Our Deadline
Lizzie often talks about how much elections matter. The leaders we elect determine how we address the issues that matter to us — or if we can address them at all . From access to affordable health care, including abortion care, to common sense gun-safety policies to keep our communities safe, we need leaders like Lizzie who will fight for the progress we need.
Elections matter, and that’s why this week’s FEC deadline matters. Our campaign team is focused on hitting our quarterly fundraising goal this week. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220628wu?refcode=lpfe220628wu_m]
We need to be prepared to run a strong campaign so we can send Lizzie back to the House where she can keep fighting for us. We set goals to make sure we have the money to do it: to talk with voters and get them to go to the polls. And we have to meet them to run the campaign we know we need to win.
Your contributions — no matter their size — really do add up. Please consider giving before the end of the day Thursday. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220628wu?refcode=lpfe220628wu_m]
Thanks for being a part of the team,
Team Lizzie
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220628wu?refcode=lpfe220628wu_m]

Jesse Reising comes from a long line of Central Illinoisans, with his ancestors arriving by horseback among the first 300 settlers in Decatur in the 1830s. He was recruited from the heartland public school system to attend and play football at Yale University. While Jesse was a starting linebacker for Yale and a Marine Corps Officer Candidate, he suffered a massive neck injury during a football game. It left him partially paralyzed and ended his plans to join the Marine Corps. Jesse set out to do three things to replace his Marine Corps Service: (1) go to Afghanistan to support the United States military’s efforts as a civilian; (2) co-found the Warrior-Scholar Project to serve those serving in the military; and (3) serve his country as a federal prosecutor. After graduating from Yale, Jesse achieved all 3 of his goals. As a federal prosecutor, Jesse prosecuted white-collar criminals and foreign business executives who were manipulating American economic markets. The cases Jesse prosecuted resulted in the recovery of over $100 million for the American taxpayer. Now Jesse is running for Congress so he can continue to protect taxpayers, strengthen the economy, stand by law enforcement, empower veterans to succeed, and protect the agriculture industry that is vital to central Illinois.

body:
| | | |
---
|
---
| | | **Dear Peter,**

Thousands of people across MD-6 are already voting and I need your help. I also have another major fundraising reporting deadline **tomorrow** , June 29!

[Can you please donate anything – $5, $25, $50, $250, or more – to our campaign?](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=faf01878b7&e=0faa9de128)

My opponent has already dumped over $2 million into his.

I’m not trying to compete with his big money, but I don’t need to. Get this: in 2016, Trone outspent Jamie Raskin 6-1, but Trone still lost.

I know we can beat Trone even if he outspends us 30-1, but getting our campaign in front of voters across our vast district still costs money! Digital ads, texts, and mail add up fast – and we just don’t have enough money to reach everyone.

**I believe our grassroots campaign is the solution to Trone’s brand of pay-to-play politics. Grassroots campaigns are only successful when everyone participates.** If we are going to elect real leaders that serve the people, not themselves, we need everyone to chip in. [Please Donate Today!](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=041504c8d5&e=0faa9de128)

I've knocked on thousands of doors from Gaithersburg to Garrett County and made thousands of personal calls. My opponent has not. That’s not his thing. He spends money. Lots of it. He buys ads. He pays canvassers. Some voters even told us they feel harassed by his barrage of ads.

Just this weekend, my opponent got booed at Frederick Pride. Voters are learning about his donations to TX Gov Abbott and TX Attorney General Paxton, and they don’t like what they hear. **We need to make sure _everyone_ gets the message.**

Voters are beginning to connect the dots between donating to extreme right-wing politicians like Abbott and Paxton and last week’s disastrous Supreme Court decision on reproductive choice.

[If everyone receiving this email donated even $5 or $10, we’d be able to reach thousands more voters and win this primary.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=1e9cee2ab6&e=0faa9de128)

Now is the time to get involved. We need you to [donate](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=0252781de8&e=0faa9de128), tell your friends, [make calls, knock on doors](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=d86f23da22&e=0faa9de128), attend one of our [three events](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=f6aa929f60&e=0faa9de128) in the next week, and host an event in your yard or even virtually!

Together we can make this happen.

Thank you,
Ben

body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5cj4l7anului77es90vqpvl490abq3a65ruslag_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm8o34chh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8sb4cup66o356upn6o3kekpncs5he3grec5kmmpm6o5lm5gmatpkmjgn8t3ie3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor1ddicup32phkcipm1ptgmlin49fg)
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrc2gr7f40u9p82hq6burhhv2p9kvc4kv86gpo08_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm8o34chh2bs) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ziu12sffdjsp1gtkevt10a6ktpj6tof17riacl7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm8o34chh2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5uecku9o9ai04j38rksphdapnqnr63sqe9ukn00_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm8o34chh2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

| | | Friends —

The Supreme Court has struck down the right to safe and legal abortion, and the protections that generations of Americans were born with are gone. It’s an enormous step back for our country.

In Arizona, Trump just endorsed one of my opponents who wants to go even further and pass a national ban on abortion in all cases — no exceptions. He even opposes the decision that made birth control legal in this country.

The stakes were high before. But now, it’s more critical than ever that we win this race, because the Senate is the final defense against abortion being banned in the United States.

As long as I’m in the Senate, I’ll work to make sure that never happens.

#
Hey Peter Willis, We have some serious problems, and it’s time for an open discussion. These issues affect more than just a few. They touch people in Georgia’s 12th, Georgia, and throughout the country, so it is time to discuss coming together as a nation.

Instead of a Meet and Greet with Liz, I decided we needed to do more. Not only do I want to hear your concerns, but I also want to provide you with information and resources. My mission has always been to empower people, and I seek your help with this initiative. I have put together a panel with myself and five of my nearest and dearest. We want to meet you, discuss these unprecedented times, learn from each other, and provide resources.

So I would love for you to participate in our virtual fundraising event this **Thursday at 7 pm.** It’s a platform where we can come together and voice our concerns. To get access to this monumental event, donate today to gain access to the registration link.

Peter,

With the Supreme Court overturning _Roe v. Wade_ it has never been more important that we elect leaders to Congress who will defend reproductive rights. And on this issue – Seth and his Republican opponent, Allan Fung, couldn't be more different.

Throughout his time serving Rhode Island, Seth has stood up for the right of women to make their own reproductive health care choices. As Treasurer, he worked to pass the Reproductive Privacy Act which codified _Roe_ into Rhode Island law. And he supports the Equal Access to Abortion Act because a women's right to reproductive health care should not depend on her health insurance.

Allan Fung on the other hand opposed codifying _Roe v. Wade_ in Rhode Island and was endorsed by RI Right to Life, a group that wants to make abortion illegal. The choice is clear this November: we need to elect Seth to defend reproductive rights – but it won't be easy.

A new poll shows Allan Fung is _leading_ the race for Rhode Island's 2nd District and that Seth is the strongest Democrat to beat Fung. In fact, Seth is the only Democrat who holds Fung to a single digit lead. We need your help to ensure we have the resources to beat Fung so we can keep RI-02 blue this November.

And on this issue – Seth and his Republican opponent, Allan Fung, couldn't be more different. Peter, With the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade it has never been more important that we elect leaders to Congress who will defend reproductive rights. And on this issue – Seth and his Republican opponent, Allan Fung, couldn't be more different. Throughout his time serving Rhode Island, Seth has stood up for the right of women to make their own reproductive health care choices. As Treasurer, he worked to pass the Reproductive Privacy Act which codified Roe into Rhode Island law. And he supports the Equal Access to Abortion Act because a women's right to reproductive health care should not depend on her health insurance. Allan Fung on the other hand opposed codifying Roe v. Wade in Rhode Island and was endorsed by RI Right to Life, a group that wants to make abortion illegal. The choice is clear this November: we need to elect Seth to defend reproductive rights – but it won't be easy. A new poll shows Allan Fung is leading the race for Rhode Island's 2nd District and that Seth is the strongest Democrat to beat Fung. In fact, Seth is the only Democrat who holds Fung to a single digit lead. name: Morton Blackwell
subject: Will you sponsor a conservative student’s scholarship
body:
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9354%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=C6vEOfY9QRB9QfANcZB99A&sysid=1)
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
|
---
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36903%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6ONN%2fIzTzbvHiYwDb6t%2bNA&sysid=1) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36904%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fv%2bxaw8e%2b3DFOMR9Djl28g&sysid=1) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36915%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DgnVeFpUXp2c3s6WmwEWIw&sysid=1) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

subject: My district used to be solid blue, Peter​

Rural America is at risk this November | | | Hi Peter – My name is Joe Miller, and I proudly represent Western Lorain County in the Ohio General Assembly. I'm a native Ohioan, and I've been working to bring quality education, good-paying jobs, opportunities for green investment, and support for our veterans to my state. **These are the issues that Democrats are fighting for, but like in many other states across the country, we've been held back by our Republican counterparts.** Now, I'm facing reelection in an extremely competitive Ohio state legislative district. My district in Lorain County is in a heavily industrial area – and it used to be a solid blue seat. Those issues that made my community blue are still going strong. People need affordable housing, a workforce-education pipeline, and infrastructure investment. **Democrats have long delivered and advocated around those core working-class priorities****. But recently, Republicans have corrupted that narrative** – urging my neighbors into culture wars instead of good debates on how to get things done. That's why it's so important that we have organizations like the United Rural Democrats to help build a movement that can reinvigorate the Democratic base in districts that are on the brink of turning red. **This November will be a crucial test, especially in districts like mine. Any support you can provide to help Democrats in rural areas is extremely important to make sure that our communities get the resources they need.[Will you consider donating anything you are able to clean_body: Rural America is at risk this November | | | Hi Peter – My name is Joe Miller, and I proudly represent Western Lorain County in the Ohio General Assembly. I'm a native Ohioan, and I've been working to bring quality education, good-paying jobs, opportunities for green investment, and support for our veterans to my state. These are the issues that Democrats are fighting for, but like in many other states across the country, we've been held back by our Republican counterparts. Now, I'm facing reelection in an extremely competitive Ohio state legislative district. My district in Lorain County is in a heavily industrial area – and it used to be a solid blue seat. Those issues that made my community blue are still going strong. People need affordable housing, a workforce-education pipeline, and infrastructure investment. Democrats have long delivered and advocated around those core working-class priorities. But recently, Republicans have corrupted that narrative – urging my neighbors into culture wars instead of good debates on how to get things done. That's why it's so important that we have organizations like the United Rural Democrats to help build a movement that can reinvigorate the Democratic base in districts that are on the brink of turning red. This November will be a crucial test, especially in districts like mine. Any support you can provide to help Democrats in rural areas is extremely important to make sure that our communities get the resources they need. body:
I feel the urgent call to serve the people of North Carolina once again.
#

I had a few minutes of free time in my schedule this morning — which is a blessing these days as we sprint toward Election Day. But I wanted to reach out to you to share some reflections and a bit about why I am running for the United States Senate.
Running for office was not something I’d ever imagined I’d do when I graduated from law school. I had never seen an African American woman sit behind the bench until I was a practicing lawyer.
But it’s a moment that changed what I saw as possible, and I went on to run for judge myself. When my first opponent said I couldn’t win because I was a mom, I beat him by 30 points. Ultimately, I went on to win two statewide races and become the first African American woman to serve as Chief Justice of North Carolina.
Now, as I watch Washington fail our families while a politicized, right-wing majority of the Supreme Court rolls back our Constitutional rights, I feel the urgent call to serve the people of North Carolina once again. My promise from the start of this campaign for U.S. Senate has been that I would pursue justice with a relentless refusal to see it abandoned.
Republicans can try to bully me just like my first opponent. Their super PACs can keep spending millions on false attack ads against me, like they’ve already done. But I refuse to back down. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward.
So I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you, and if you help me win, I will cast the decisive 51st vote for progress — on abortion rights, voting rights, climate action and more.
North Carolina has been rated by experts as one of only three likely pick-up opportunities for Democrats. But the truth is I simply cannot do this alone.
[**So I’m humbly asking you to make a $3 contribution to our campaign today to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority. clean_body: I feel the urgent call to serve the people of North Carolina once again. I had a few minutes of free time in my schedule this morning — which is a blessing these days as we sprint toward Election Day. But I wanted to reach out to you to share some reflections and a bit about why I am running for the United States Senate. Running for office was not something I’d ever imagined I’d do when I graduated from law school. I had never seen an African American woman sit behind the bench until I was a practicing lawyer. But it’s a moment that changed what I saw as possible, and I went on to run for judge myself. When my first opponent said I couldn’t win because I was a mom, I beat him by 30 points. Ultimately, I went on to win two statewide races and become the first African American woman to serve as Chief Justice of North Carolina. Now, as I watch Washington fail our families while a politicized, right-wing majority of the Supreme Court rolls back our Constitutional rights, I feel the urgent call to serve the people of North Carolina once again. My promise from the start of this campaign for U.S. Senate has been that I would pursue justice with a relentless refusal to see it abandoned. Republicans can try to bully me just like my first opponent. Their super PACs can keep spending millions on false attack ads against me, like they’ve already done. But I refuse to back down. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward. So I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you, and if you help me win, I will cast the decisive 51st vote for progress — on abortion rights, voting rights, climate action and more. North Carolina has been rated by experts as one of only three likely pick-up opportunities for Democrats. But the truth is I simply cannot do this alone. | Derek, it’s official: _Roe v. Wade_ has been overturned by the U.S. Supreme Court.

It’s been a hard few weeks since this decision was leaked, but now it’s _real_ — and I’m sure you’re angry, frustrated, and scared about what this means. I am too.

**But this decision means the next Governor will have the ability to sign — or veto — that legislation. Derek, I will veto _any bill_ that restricts a woman’s right to choose — and with this news, we know that’s going to be one of the most consequential decisions our next Governor makes.**

[**Derek, we must win this race to keep abortion safe, legal, and accessible in Pennsylvania. It is literally up to us. Can you donate whatever feels right to you in this moment to help defend reproductive rights in Pennsylvania and elect Chris Deluzio to Congress?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47101557/353069053/-688911513?refcode=em_fr_2022.06.28_b2_js_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWI2NDY1MC0xYWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2m9rKpWfEejRkrgZN-LraHb_1dLrlUN3RznLiAg6bus=)

You probably know a grandparent, aunt, parent, sibling, or even yourself who marched for the right to choose fifty years ago, before _Roe v. Wade_ became the law of the land.

I’ve met people who marched back then — people who are furious and tired that they have to do this all over again for something they thought was set in stone — a right that we all thought would be protected forever.

**I want you to know that I’m furious too. That I will not ever back down from protecting the right to choose in Pennsylvania — from protecting women’s lives.**

Due to the Supreme Court’s decision, each and every state will decide whether the women who reside there can have an abortion.

**So with a Republican Legislature that’s tried time and time again to restrict abortion access (even through a constitutional amendment), we can be certain they’ll send a bill severely limiting abortion access in Pennsylvania to the desk of the next Governor.**

[**Know this: abortion remains legal in Pennsylvania — and will remain legal if I’m elected Governor. Can you donate $15 or whatever you can today to elect a pro-choice Governor in Pennsylvania and elect Chris Deluzio to Congress?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47101558/353069054/-688911513?refcode=em_fr_2022.06.28_b2_js_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWI2NDY1MC0xYWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2m9rKpWfEejRkrgZN-LraHb_1dLrlUN3RznLiAg6bus=)

These past few weeks have been tough — but I know that we have the voice, the strength, and the determination to keep abortion access legal in Pennsylvania.

Together, we can do this.

Josh Shapiro __ |
