name: Tom Brejcha
subject: 9 felonies for exposing Planned Parenthood
body:
I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zrogd7a5470aep5s61d5jarsucs8hj5gv3usei98_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf4t37cdireo9i66on1oln6sqm4thjeiqeadtle4r74opm6hh72s33mdhj9p1ks3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor1ddicup38phh6ipm1ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdim6ob1c5hm8p324no)
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zt8kc6fkn7b0qvdob8qe3s021ifv7mtr2bgl9lo0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm2or4chh2bs)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1quvfipebefuib9in0tqtdo5ildjl3d8get8nmo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm2or4chh2bs)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zldgbth98f96hh0c6eagsfhlol9opfv3gpitinf0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm2or4chh2bs)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. Friend: We are witnessing the power of Democratic majorities in Congress before our very eyes. If Republicans had been in charge, we would likely still be in the dark about a host of chilling details pertaining to the Jan. 6 insurrection and the GOP plot to overturn a free and fair election.
What we've learned so far is astounding:
Donald Trump pursued plans tantamount to a coup - even though senior members of his administration and own family advised him that there was _no_ widespread election fraud.

Ginni Thomas, wife of Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas, reportedly communicated directly with local officials in Arizona, urging them to overturn President Biden's victory in the state. The impact has been just as swift and severe as we imagined. The moment we have feared is here. Everything is on the line. With Roe dismantled, the GOP will turn all of their attention to gaining control of Congress – so they can continue passing legislation restricting our reproductive choice and right to access healthcare. Over half the states are moving to criminalize abortion. People are already being turned away from clinics. Our pro-choice majority in the House is one of the few things standing between us and a nationwide abortion ban. If you are ready to help me fight back,= Abortion access is not the only fight we’ve undertaken. Read on to learn more about what I’ve been working for in Washington. Congress did something last week that no one thought possible – we passed legislation to save lives from gun violence. I voted for the “Bipartisan Safer Communities Act,” comprehensive gun violence prevention legislation to stop the spread of gun violence and help prevent future mass casualty shootings. Still, this bill falls short of where we ultimately need to be to end the epidemic of gun violence in this country – so the work continues. I am also watching the January 6th committee hearings and reckoning with just how close we came – at multiple levels of government – to losing our 200+ year democracy. We cannot take our democracy for granted. The anti-democratic forces unleashed and amplified by the far-right make the future of democracy in America more uncertain than ever. I’m prepared to hold the line for our values, our democracy, and our country in Congress. You know where I stand on these issues. I've said it. I've shown it. I've voted on it. Wow, my jaw is on the floor.

During today’s surprise January 6th hearing, the committee presented brand-new, damning evidence against Donald Trump.

Here’s just a sampling of what was uncovered today:
* **Trump attacked a Secret Service agent who refused to drive him to the Capitol building,** lunging for the steering wheel.
* **Trump and his chief of staff Mark Meadows knew the insurrectionists had weapons,** including AR-15s.
* Trump refused to talk down the mob, claiming they **_“weren’t there to hurt him (Trump)” — and “Mike (Pence) deserves it”._**

I’m outraged by these new developments. We must hold Trump and his cronies — _like my ultra-MAGA opponent Elise Stefanik_ — accountable for these crimes.

**We demand that Democrats take the following five steps to restore our reproductive rights and ensure that our equality is never questioned again:**
1. End or carve out an exception to the filibuster

2. Codify _Roe v. Wade_

3. Unrig and Expand the Court

4. Repeal the Hyde Amendment

5. Ratify the E.R.A.

Democratic leadership has a moral obligation to use its power to protect the reproductive rights of women, trans men, and non-binary people. **We are calling on President Joe Biden, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, and Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi to take the actions outlined above,_immediately_.**
Every day that goes by without action is another day where someone is harmed. body:

Team,
Over the past few months, we’ve emailed you about the various goings-on within the Michigan GOP. And as June comes to an end, we thought it would be a perfect time to recap an extremely chaotic few months.
To sum up:
In April, the Michigan GOP held their nominating convention, and conspiracies – like denying the results of the 2020 election – were front and center. A chaotic process exposed some serious fractures within the party and left longtime conservatives feeling alienated. Cracks in the system are more and more apparent.
The DeVos family came bursting back onto the political scene, including former Trump Education Secretary Betsy DeVos. Our opponent has been a consistent supporter of her initiatives in the state legislature, including defunding our schools, and coincidentally... the DeVos family not only hosted Barrett for a fundraiser, they supported his campaign to the tune of $50,000 in one day!
That’s not where the chaos stops. 5 out of 10 GOP gubernatorial candidates, including some of the would-be frontrunners, didn’t get enough nominating petition signatures to get on the ballot. There were thousands upon thousands of fraudulent ballot signatures. The party that has spent so much time claiming "fraud" in the 2020 election actively sought to use fraud to get on the ballot .
But it doesn’t stop there. Recently, one of the remaining gubernatorial candidates was *arrested* for his involvement in the January 6th riots at the U.S. Capitol. The speaker of the Michigan Senate was subpoenaed by the January 6th committee, where he was asked, in part, about a trip that he made (along with Elissa's opponent) in November 2020 to the White House for a meeting with Trump to discuss the results of the election.
It’s enough to make your head spin, and these are only the highlights of the last few months. All of this makes it clear – what was once the party of Lincoln has lost its bearings, and they’re not capable of leading us through such a critical moment.

name: Jared Moskowitz
subject: Hillary Clinton endorsed my campaign!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

I’m incredibly honored and excited to share that today, Secretary Hillary Clinton endorsed our campaign!

I’ve known Secretary Clinton since I was 12 years old. Since then, she has been one of my greatest role models and my Democratic values have been shaped significantly by her example of advocacy, leadership, and impact.

As a world leader who has spent decades fighting for reproductive rights and to bring this nation’s gun violence epidemic under control, Secretary Clinton knows that Washington needs more lawmakers who will stand up for gun violence prevention, women's rights, and more.

As the first woman to win the Democratic nomination for President, Secretary Clinton has been a fighter for reproductive rights for her entire career. In the wake of the Supreme Court’s devastating decision overturning Roe v. Wade , her support of my candidacy makes me want to fight even harder to codify the right to abortion in federal law upon winning election to the US House.

I am proud to stand with Secretary Clinton and millions of women across the country in the fight for reproductive freedom.

I’m incredibly proud to have her support and I look forward to continuing the fights she has championed for her entire life.

With Gratitude,

Jared Moskowitz

As of the time I wrote this email to you, Florida Republicans have a 189,000 lead in voter registrations over Florida Democrats.

This is the Democrats’ worst fear. We know liberals will stop at nothing to best their opponents, so we need to be prepared for the onslaught of attacks that are sure to ensue as they try to make sense of these numbers.

Can you step up so that we are well-prepared for their next attack?

name: Brandon Tatum
subject: BLM vs Blexit
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpoaeos6q088gfhp4oc9abgnng03itnapnhjero8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqnasb6c5r79ptlc9gjbdbgmlg6ep76mlgj0p5je9h64c9geop7ccdkc9hm2sr0sv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6pj3applmhjr5cr66hgb4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clhm2ob0s9j60oh5u)
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze1gfg745lqh1r8uei11ntjilhs982ffaa3r712g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zt7nmsd5h896oulno0dr90lgk0507hqk7kukik28_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zemhg0mk05g3h7ch1uidqmm4bermiv7civ69sls0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkinqm4o6v7v2s92892q47q7rlo6tvaf5lsg8ap0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0gl6sr1jmdo5jlsveuj6seq4tvhcn7iql6qo82o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgqoqj0q43ofp75ij1hk3cv282dd8enei6o9u8c0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zuadhutkuqs59mol29rmhb5amm3re7ithuu9lcmo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zr8t3auqc5oaf4hj0a2mq2932nrpa5rra82kojeo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z118uiveqtk694pvpuj2hp7ugecputhritnfrek8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8k8s5k0qriv3q6suvs6ea5rljtmtgtrjf4ih31o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6nhg0vrhlb1pv4souo97g3k8b6mo6h6ckveud48_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zctqhao59f5bj7es2000vnpq7roc55ap168eeeu8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zejde5nkksmcgh1ccq7n6rqj15fpg6b7idtheibg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8e47mmkldi4p82d268o7pibdd3hb463iigm27to_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zs3kgepn8gs1aiju58ho4br6a94r4ueineqls11o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvouplmbr6efkps4pl3rhl9clcf8tb5k6mt6g3kg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za61aq01cm4lhubv0ok1po9loeag7r1usk9l2n2o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zob84bbgli54nudu22bjv6tf6qkdbcd1hsjmo548_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zls4eqb2orsgkvnqnlard37ihc9ej2orbsm65heg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zriovr0nlef57bn70f13q9pac5ck3ggng0nvut7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkjmu620faujg2ash930rjnhq6hmho6aq4emerm0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1oj6c1h2bs)

People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?"

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_" If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor." \- Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation

[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3l2flo3u4ktsgm4gau8al9q86lgkj9v2fs9r5g0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqrfc5jmlr30phnmopr7c36cji36o9mcor7eobl6iqn0srj6pg62cbgclq70tbgcv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6pj3applmhg74dj665ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clhm2ob0slhmeoh5u)
This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z606aken64c4jvaf2io7hqemcjuq42d3cedmlhn0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1pb3cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z49gusuqokqkjpo0len42v3jtru3n1ecc7cktsno_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1pb3cth2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zn3dj8ed8ipdki84iisf0dhmg6iunr14suv8rj5g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gm1pb3cth2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

body:
Now I’ll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ze0e3g0pq3blfh1qkpb274d58ljfc8apq163idu0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gmepb3clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqcdtjmpqj4srk65qb6t9j6toj79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onmm5r32c74sthn2d3ic2o6apjncpgbasb46lh6cobmepqm4cr46lhred5geir3eduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdgmmp6fchncoor1ddk6uobapbi4no)
[](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zhjmfr3gd3u6evq6k88r4ktocorkq5nvlndeo2rg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gmepb3clh2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z9nc6ck1q2rbevg30nq540c665usuocbsn91avjo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gmepb3clh2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zih90e2av1gqr6df2ehmkgkh1d7m2k57hb64mdrg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gmepb3clh2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zimakt85oju3rp7bsiq16k5qv96f5g19rnki25a8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gmepb3clh2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z66j38l24ma8u5f36vuairfajd5d95c70rgmh3jo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gmepb3clh2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z8vpt0iake54tc6mkb5qvkb1ctp3dde32jgr9sr8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gmepb3clh2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4ss8r428mm3941c9dp8ac5f0gjmns1j8858a930_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5gmepb3clh2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! body:

Congress is out of session this week (phew!), and we are heading into Independence Day next week. So, we have a really easy call to action for you this week.
---
|
---
[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._A)
---
**Poll Watching and Poll Working** Election integrity is a year-round effort. It’s something that we have to stay on top of all the time, partially because the left is constantly agitating and working for election changes that will permanently make it easier to cheat. They do this day-in and day-out. One way that you can thwart their efforts is to simply [**sign up to be a poll watcher or poll worker**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.). The thing is, the training for those positions for the November election will begin soon. Therefore, this week’s call to action is to simply [**fill out this form today**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._1d8Px4A) and let us know that you want to be connected to the trainings in your state. We will then get you connected, so that you can keep an eye on the election in your area. This may seem like such a small, insignificant action, but we always know what’s really a threat by the way the left reacts. And boy, are they reacting. There have been so many fear-mongering hit pieces about the “army” of conservatives who are signing up to watch elections, and how this is a “threat” to “democracy.” The bottom line is that the left does not want you to be a poll watcher or poll worker, period. So, you should probably [**sign up**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-RpmLmGIA9Y9A) right now!
---
[SIGN UP](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
| | |

| | More than half the nation’s school board associations [have withdrawn from the National School Boards Association](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NDg4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/_WbcmQ9DLT7RqU48QpedrA) (NSBA) over its collusion with the Biden administration’s anti-parent agendas. Their exodus comes after the NSBA sent a letter to the Justice Department in September 2021 asking the Justice Department to investigate parents for “domestic terrorism.” The state associations follow the lead of the Wisconsin Association of School Boards (WASB), the first to cut ties with the NSBA. Meanwhile, President Biden has created a “National Parents and Families Engagement Council” ostensibly to ease parental concerns over education. But, given that the board is comprised of people who defended the NSBA’s inflammatory letter to the Justice Department, [some say that the group will do nothing](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NDg4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/4s73g5FibbBOML4GVy4Cyg) to quell parental distress.
---
| | |
---
[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
A group called the Civic Alliance, organized by the National Associations of Scholars, has just officially launched their model K-12 social studies standards called American Birthright. They sum up their goal this way: _The Civics Alliance wants to improve every aspect of American social studies instruction by inspiring America’s state education departments to provide social studies standards that teach American students their birthright of liberty._ On their website is a treasure trove of resources for state legislators, activists, parents, etc. Please take some time to go through their materials, and let’s see if we can’t change the standards across the country that form the foundation of the curriculum that is being taught to American children! ---
|

| | The Biden Department of Homeland Security [announced three new pipelines](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._tnLA) for refugee resettlement, one of which gives Afghans associated with the Taliban special U.S. entry privileges. Since the U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan in 2021, the Biden administration has allowed more than 85,000 Afghan refugees to resettle without prior screening. But their recent decision gives “individuals who provided insignificant or certain limited material support to a designated terrorist organization” a special pass. The administration deems individuals’ financial ties to the Taliban as “insignificant” because of the group’s “control of entities, roads and utilities.” But American citizens should be wary of the president’s lax attitude towards potential security threats. A Department of Defense [report](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) previously revealed that only 3 out of 31 Afghan refugees could be located after resettlement into the United States. Another 50 have already been flagged for “significant security concerns” as of November 2021.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, it’s
primary day for Justice Democrat Kina Collins in IL-7! Here’s what we’re
up against:

President Biden endorsed Kina’s opponent just 2 days ago. It’s a sign of
desperation when a corporate Democrat needs the President to intervene in
a Democratic primary.

Nancy Pelosi has been campaigning and fundraising for Kina’s opponent for
months. Corporate super PACs have spent at least $500,000 against Kina.
Fossil fuel companies, private prison groups, and big Republican donors
have all made big contributions to try to defeat Kina and our movement.

It’s big corporate money, the President, and the Speaker of the House
against us in IL-7. The powerful and the wealthy in this country are doing
all they can to stop Justice Democrats. A win today for Kina would shake
up the political establishment once again, at a time when it really needs
to be shaken up.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110930?refcode=em20220628-24050&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=24050%2E1203867%2EelfmWP ]Donate $3 to Justice Democrats to help us win another
primary against the entire political establishment. While corporate
Democrats defend the status quo for their donors, we will fight for a
better future.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110930?refcode=em20220628-24050&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=24050%2E1203867%2EelfmWP ]Contribute

With all of the inaction in the face of right-wing extremism, Pres. Biden
took time to endorse against a young, working-class Black woman and
survivor of gun violence in a Democratic primary.

Shouldn’t the White House and Nancy Pelosi focus on defeating Republicans
in November? Shouldn’t they focus on acting in the face of abortion rights
being stripped from tens of millions of people, instead of trying to stop
Kina? Shouldn’t Biden and Pelosi be siding with the people instead of
corporate donors?

The last week, the last year, and the last decade have shown the
Democratic Party has its priorities severely mixed up. We don’t need party
leaders lining up with big corporations to protect incumbents because
they’re threatened by change. We need new voices and genuine fighters for
the people like Kina in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110930?refcode=em20220628-24050&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=24050%2E1203867%2EelfmWP ]Today is a big day in this fight to change the Democratic
Party, Peter.
Can you donate to Justice Democrats right now so we can lift Kina to a
huge victory in IL-7?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110930?refcode=em20220628-24050&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=24050%2E1203867%2EelfmWP ]Contribute

A win today for Kina will grow the Squad and make Democratic leaders face
the growing pressure on them to make real, progressive change for the
people.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

| Team,

Since the fall of _Roe_ by a Trump-packed Supreme Court on Friday, it's now up to the states to protect a woman's right to bodily autonomy and reproductive freedom.

But Ohio Republicans have been clear on just how backward their positions are on a woman's right to choose.

**Governor Mike DeWine** signed an executive order hours after the Supreme Court ruling that would ban abortions in Ohio at just six weeks – with zero exceptions for rape or incest.

**Senate nominee JD Vance** called making abortion illegal an “amazing victory” and considers rape to be "inconvenient" but an "opportunity" for women.

**Attorney General Dave Yost** said he would like to press charges against women who have abortions and the doctors who perform them.

**Ohio – the stakes this November are huge.** Vance, DeWine, and Yost don't have what it takes to move our state forward – only backward.

clean_body: We have only five weeks to win this primary, Peter. | | | | | Peter, If you can believe it, we are just 5 weeks away from the Republican Primary on August 2nd. It's been a long and incredible journey - today marks 14 months since I announced I was running for Governor to defeat Gretchen Whitmer and restore the freedoms and prosperity she had taken from the citizens of Michigan. Now, with 5 weeks to go until the primary and just 3 days until our end-of-month finance deadline, our movement is leaving it all on the field. Can you make a contribution today to help us finish strong? Click here to donate: Our fundraising in the final stretch will be absolutely crucial to victory on August 2nd. Right now, the airwaves are being flooded with ads from special interests trying to buy this race for establishment candidates. We're being outspent on television ads - and every dollar donated will help keep up on TV. Will you help our grassroots campaign level the playing field by pitching in just $5 at ? Republicans deserve a candidate with a record of fighting alongside the grassroots to stop Governor Whitmer's tyranny. I know where I have been....... The campaign we've built with our grassroots warriors is truly extraordinary - but it's time to hammer down like never before to get the job done. subject: A fellow fighter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Rebecca
body:
Why I’m throwing my support behind Rebecca Kleefisch for governor.
| Friend,
---
In August of 2012, while deployed in Afghanistan, nine members of my platoon and I were hit by an IED explosion. The blast resulted in the amputation of both of my legs.
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=fe89b1318ebf4a15871cae40d01a29a1&_m=216d110905944c12b12354e5af61c6dd&_e=5WgEfG07k_vx8uYlSpUxTbFk8bvNH9Zo6oGFsyQQRC2oj_sG03UaP3NTLB88mYLTw86ViK4PdYzuqt1MtGAsfo9iBJYuF8PPuERDDe9m3qfVRhFcWmAxa9tfs_T7UYpv2wP1ZdO4BuJdORVEZUplmm40HI4DeEfbD9A0JmTWprb7evqQIGU2z0f0UEVJovPFCIiJxSoBY5gqTqzjUnd0Czym-bCD1pjsLGkkkyZSBU4tRTaBDXevuls3vFjL4h71wUWpyd0U2bCG41s63HgpQxg93E27UoCItC0LP7buOdcF_8hboK3eD0zEFfcjZErNXbdBAZ7bwCwQruewodpKdyYi2cSR1j9bRmDJop4A31xA4XlJZrDj0MpvsOgFoXs-1iTcDI-u86eag2g-73BywghP0htcXiaDPKQdWyELPhlyB7wxOJhB_dsO_n384sCLy97mCq5PJUWyu2oQDFqaIc9hhs-369vJcb9zp4ACEqBQ0--2hqI_Fa51YBCRBd-x3iyeaOfBRu90-Q3w95RCsA%3D%3D)
---
While my tour ended the day I lost my legs, _the fight didn’t_. During my recovery, my dad got activated and took my other pair of boots with him to finish out their tour in Afghanistan.
---
So if there’s one thing I admire above all else, it’s grit and determination.**_And that’s why I’m throwing my support behind Rebecca Kleefisch for governor._**
---
_She’s a true fighter. She battled cancer all while continuing to fight the liberal special interests in Madison with Governor Walker. And she NEVER backs down._
---
But I know as well as anyone that even the toughest Wisconsinites among us still need those who will fight by our side.**Which is why I’m asking YOU to join me in supporting Rebecca.**
---

clean_body: Why I’m throwing my support behind Rebecca Kleefisch for governor. | Friend, In August of 2012, while deployed in Afghanistan, nine members of my platoon and I were hit by an IED explosion. The blast resulted in the amputation of both of my legs. While my tour ended the day I lost my legs, the fight didn’t. During my recovery, my dad got activated and took my other pair of boots with him to finish out their tour in Afghanistan. So if there’s one thing I admire above all else, it’s grit and determination.And that’s why I’m throwing my support behind Rebecca Kleefisch for governor. She’s a true fighter. She battled cancer all while continuing to fight the liberal special interests in Madison with Governor Walker. And she NEVER backs down. But I know as well as anyone that even the toughest Wisconsinites among us still need those who will fight by our side.Which is why I’m asking YOU to join me in supporting Rebecca. Tony Evers has failed the people of Wisconsin. Just like Joe Biden, he’s more concerned with pleasing union bosses than putting your interests FIRST. But this year, we can finally FIRE Evers, and Rebecca is the only conservative with the fight, the determination, and the experience to get the job done. It’s why Governor Walker endorsed her, and it’s why I’ve endorsed her... ...But the endorsement she needs most is YOURS, Friend. Thank you, Jason Church U.S. Army Captain (Ret.) Under a strong Democratic majority, the House has made real progress on the challenges our nation faces. We have taken steps to address gun safety, including the passage of my legislation to expand the use of red flag laws nationwide to reduce gun deaths. We have continued to invest in critical infrastructure projects, and are taking concrete action to address our climate emergency. BREAKING: Andrew Yang just endorsed our campaign for U.S. Senate!
We are so excited and proud to have 2020 presidential candidate and fellow political reformer Andrew Yang on Team Olikara!
"It brings me great hope to endorse Steven Olikara for U.S. Senate. Wisconsin voters are feeling the effects of a broken system in their daily lives and they have a candidate ready to take these issues head-on...With 21st century solutions and pragmatic policies like term limits, nonpartisan primaries and ranked choice voting Steven will bring a real voice to all Wisconsinites." - Andrew Yang, 2020 presidential candidate.
I’m thrilled to welcome the Yang Gang in our fight for a new kind of politics in Wisconsin; one where elected officials are incentivized to serve the people, not their big money donors. Andrew Yang inspired millions of people to believe in renewing our democracy and making government work for the exhausted majority. We must enact structural reform if we’re going to see real change. That’s what I’m here to do.
Now, we are just a few days away from our end-of-month deadline to reach 5,000 unique donors and get on to the debate stage this summer. Organizations across the country are mobilizing to help knock down financial and logistical barriers for those seeking abortion access, and I'd like to ask for your help in funding this critical mission. These organizations are helping women nationwide with travel costs if they live in a state that has restricted abortion access, child care, transportation, and so much more. clean_body: | | | | The Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade , effectively ending the right to a safe and legal abortion in America. We need to talk about where we go from here. Millions of Americans are rightfully scared about what comes next. The days, weeks, and months ahead won't be easy, but there are a few things we can do right now to help women living in states that have already restricted abortion access in light of the Supreme Court's ruling. Organizations across the country are mobilizing to help knock down financial and logistical barriers for those seeking abortion access, and I'd like to ask for your help in funding this critical mission. These organizations are helping women nationwide with travel costs if they live in a state that has restricted abortion access, child care, transportation, and so much more. In the meantime, there is much more work to do on the road to November. It has never been more important to expand a Democratic majority in the House and Senate that will do whatever it takes to codify Roe into law and protect abortion access for generations to come. That includes taking to the streets in protest, registering new voters across America up until Election Day, and sending a message that Donald Trump's allies have taken their extremism way, way too far. That means we have to hold a commanding majority in the Senate. I know the coming weeks and months are uncertain for so many of us, but together we're going to build a generational response to protect our constitutional rights for years to come. And that includes ensuring our grassroots campaigns from Oregon to Washington D.C. and everywhere in between have the organizational resources they need to win, and win big. This fight won't be easy, but I'm in it all the way. Please join me. We'll be talking with the founder of the 203 PAC, Cindy Purvis, about how to best work together to make changes to the PA House and make sure all organizations working on progressive issues win. Our other panelist is lifelong progressive activist Rebecca Pruveadenti, who is a former board member of Health Care 4 All PA and NW PA NOW. This is a must-attend event, so please sign up now!

Join us tomorrow: Wednesday, June 29, 2022 from 5:30 PM to 7:00 PM

Along the campaign trail, I've had the chance to put together the three main parts of our pitch to voters, so I'll share those with you quickly: 1\. [I’m a Democrat running for one of the only "open seats" in the country](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47109738/353101607/161715760?amount=3&refcode=NBFC_20220628_EMDF_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDk4ODhkYy0zMWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rZZmcsoVffXuTSX49yJDz1RI5WFneunf21hYIllOVy4=) — it was held by a Republican, but now he's running for a different seat. It's a massive opportunity for us to win. Now election experts are saying this race will be an ultra-competitive toss-up.

2\. [Republicans know that we can win.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47109740/353101609/161715760?amount=3&refcode=NBFC_20220628_EMDF_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDk4ODhkYy0zMWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rZZmcsoVffXuTSX49yJDz1RI5WFneunf21hYIllOVy4=) In past elections, they spent millions of dollars to hold this seat. They know that if we win here, it’ll be much harder for them to win the House.

3\. [I'm running a campaign based on issues, not on fear and division.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47109743/353101612/161715760?amount=3&refcode=NBFC_20220628_EMDF_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDk4ODhkYy0zMWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rZZmcsoVffXuTSX49yJDz1RI5WFneunf21hYIllOVy4=) I spent my career successfully advocating to expand labor rights and raise the minimum wage for workers. I hope this all resonates with you and that you believe I'm in this race for the right reasons, unlike politicians who do and say outrageous things just to get attention.

So here's where I ask for your help: We’re still $758 short of Primary Day goal. If we don’t raise that much by midnight, we’ll have a harder time building the robust voter contact operation we need to flip this open seat.

[It's so easy to get cynical with politics, but I'm asking you to hang on to hope with me. Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... The timing couldn't be more important. "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJx9kE1rhDAURX-N7pR8jDEuXEyZsSuHMhW6DDF5alpjJImU_vtmSrstvNWBy3336FYrLbHKTUsQIYgRjvmpQqzUWHLAGihw3jBKsxOSK_hYetiPcTVKblGGj8l5BaVyNl_aqSa6qcYJw0RVVckTRwoxyhlVuIG6zt960Uuzmm2-SQutj5PwWxTRhmL08K4WKVhBeEGIIPnaLjHuIaPnjHTpAqjDQyk30C4-GhOLi7MyWOchOGUgfiWmMEKYVAzhaWxYo1GF8JjR7ohWBHekdzN6ebo8F_frLSPsgS1oc9iEr_0vUdLu0sxbYn9eRMqIoX8Vl0GkqHg5F_ehy32r90-zriawOjmabRr44yP-v-8bBjN4cw)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment – they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. My name is Tom Brejcha. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS. In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases. The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. name: Team Lira
subject: Only three days left
body:
Peter, did you see our last email?

Yesterday we announced our End of Quarter fundraising goal to raise $16,076 by midnight on Thursday.

We’ve seen donations come in since then, but we really need to pick up the pace if we’re going to meet our goal. Can you chip in $7 to help us get there?

Donate $7 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-202206-eoq?refcode=em20220628]

These End of Quarter goals are absolutely vital to the success and financial health of this campaign.

Goals like this one help us plan for the upcoming quarter so we know what we will be able to accomplish — and if we don’t meet this goal, our work could be massively slowed down over the next few months.

Without the resources we need, we will be hard-pressed to continue reaching out to voters, making sure John is able to travel around the district to attend events and meet constituents, and getting this campaign in front of people across TX-23.

This is one of the most competitive races in Texas, Peter — the last thing we need is a slowdown of our work.

Will you jump on board now with a $7 donation to ensure we are able to meet our $16,076 goal and keep up our organizing efforts in the next quarter?

[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-202206-eoq?refcode=em20220628]

Let’s get to work,
Team Lira

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Team Lira [info@liraforcongress.com]
Date: Jun 27, 2022 6:19 PM
Subject: The last three months

Peter,

We know the last three months have been dark ones — seeing constitutional rights overturned and the worst mass shooting in a decade have been heartbreaking.

As we wrap up our second quarter since winning the primary, it’s clear the stakes are higher than ever.

That’s why we’ve set an End of Quarter Goal for this campaign that is both ambitious and specific, because we want to make sure we have exactly what we need to gear up for the summer.

We’ve set a high bar for ourselves — we want to raise $16,076 by midnight on Thursday. Can you jump in now and contribute whatever you can towards our goal?

CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-202206-eoq?refcode=em20220628]

Here’s what we were thinking about when we calculated our End of Quarter Goal:

1. What do we need to do to go into the rest of the summer stronger than ever?
There are a lot of eyes on this race, Peter. This race has quickly become the most competitive district in Texas and our opponents will be watching to see what our numbers look like going into the next quarter. We need to send a message that shows just how serious we are about fighting for Texas.

2. How can we respond to attacks from our opponent?
This part of the race is where things are getting messy. The GOP, the NRA, and dozens of other corporate and special groups have a lot riding on Tony Gonzales. They’re scared of what this campaign means for them — that’s why they are ALREADY attacking us. Our opponents are trying to discredit the strength of our campaign and we need to be prepared to respond to any attacks they try to throw our way.

3. What resources do we need to reach as many voters as possible on the ground?
Moving forward, voter contact is the most important thing we can do — but this part of campaigning isn’t cheap. We need resources to be able to make phone calls, knock doors, pass out literature, and get John around the district to talk to people.

Going into the rest of summer, we need your help to finish out this quarter strong and hit our $16,076 goal. If you have the means, will you donate now to help us gear up for the coming months?

Let’s get to work,
Team Lira

Content warning: insulting language toward rape survivors

Team,
Since Friday’s Supreme Court ruling overturning _Roe_ , an Ohio law went into effect banning all abortions after six weeks of pregnancy, with no exception for rape.
That’s bad enough – but unfortunately, it gets worse. Here’s how one Ohio Republican just defended the bill’s lack of rape exception on CNN:
_**“You don't know you were raped for 2 months?”**_
**[We cannot let Republican lawmakers’ ignorance and cruelty toward women determine abortion laws in Ohio – and the only way to fight back is to elect a governor who will veto their nonsense. Contribute $5 right now to elect a pro-choice governor in Ohio.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47112098/353109231/-320037227?refcode=nw_em_220628_2_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1N2M1MTYyMS0zOGY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4DysW6mn4j9Xw6emezBy9nuxs_k-sVzgCegBGYCcbXU=)**
Let’s be clear about two things:
1. Pregnancies are dated from the first day of a menstrual cycle, not the date of conception. Most people who are “six weeks pregnant” have actually been pregnant for four weeks and known for two weeks or less. Many people have been pregnant for even less time.
2. **Lawmakers who don’t know this basic information about pregnancy – or don’t care – have no business legislating our personal medical decisions.**

Even before the Supreme Court ruling, Ohio Republican lawmakers have been showing their extremist true colors. Two Republican members of the state legislature spoke out about their opposition to an exception for rape victims in their abortion bans, with one even referring to pregnancy after rape as “an opportunity.”
And it may still get worse: The 6-week ban already makes most abortions in Ohio illegal in practice, but now, Republicans are also considering a total ban on abortion care in our state.
The cruelty and extremism from Ohio Republicans is astounding – and it does not reflect what Ohioans want. We need pro-choice leadership that will protect our personal decisions.

**[We can and must elect a pro-choice governor in Ohio this fall to fight the GOP’s extreme agenda. Contribute $5 to elect Nan Whaley right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47112099/353109232/-320037227?refcode=nw_em_220628_2_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1N2M1MTYyMS0zOGY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4DysW6mn4j9Xw6emezBy9nuxs_k-sVzgCegBGYCcbXU=)**

Thank you,
Team Nan

Fellow American,

Though we posted strong numbers in our primary election on May 3rd, **we did not reach our goal of picking up the 20,000 endorsements we set out to collect ahead of the vote**.

Some say that our district should be safe for Republicans in November, but with almost half the district as “new territory”, we are not taking any chances. **The way people lose is to forget who they are, where they come from and who they represent.** I’ve seen former colleagues make this mistake before; I made a vow to myself to never become complacent.

So, here we are once again, **five months until Election Day,** and if we learned anything from the Supreme Court leak last week, the entire political landscape can be changed by a single event.

clean_body: We've missed our endorsement goal. Please send your endorsement today. It’s Rep. Jim Jordan. We were just reviewing our records and noticed your status is still pending. Will you please confirm before midnight tonight? | Fellow American, Though we posted strong numbers in our primary election on May 3rd, we did not reach our goal of picking up the 20,000 endorsements we set out to collect ahead of the vote. Some say that our district should be safe for Republicans in November, but with almost half the district as “new territory”, we are not taking any chances. The way people lose is to forget who they are, where they come from and who they represent. I’ve seen former colleagues make this mistake before; I made a vow to myself to never become complacent. So, here we are once again, five months until Election Day, and if we learned anything from the Supreme Court leak last week, the entire political landscape can be changed by a single event. I’m gearing up for the election to safe this country, and I’m asking if you have the time, please consider doing so today. Please help me reach our goal of finding 20,000 endorsements by the end of this week. We’re just 1,408 short at the moment, but we’re confident that the hill isn’t too steep. Let’s get this done. Thanks, Jim Don't want to receive our emails? | Paid for by Jim Jordan for Congress PO BOX 355 Delaware, OH 43015

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ducey for Governor
body:
Two editorials you can't miss about Arizona's new school choice legislation
Hello,
Arizona has blazed the trail with educational choice from open enrollment, to charter schools, and now universal Education Savings Accounts available to every K-12 student. There are not one, but two, editorials in the Wall Street Journal about how Arizona is leading other states. Both are worth your time to read.

** Can the GOP Become the Parents’ Party?
------------------------------------------------------------

**
By passing a historic school-choice bill, Arizona Republicans say yes.
------------------------------------------------------------
By Corey DeAngelis

Republicans across the country are calling themselves the Parents’ Party. Republicans in Arizona just proved they’re worthy of the name.

During his State of the State address in January, Arizona Republican Gov. Doug Ducey told the Legislature: “This session, let’s expand school choice any way we can. . . . Send me the bills, and I’ll sign them.” Republican lawmakers were listening. Last week, on two party-line votes, the Arizona House and Senate passed a monumental school-choice bill, which will soon be delivered to the governor’s desk.

The state’s efforts come after what many have called the year of school choice. After months of power-hungry teachers’ unions fighting for school closings and political indoctrination in the classroom in 2021, 18 states chose to enact or expand programs to fund students instead of systems. Arizona just one-upped all of them.

Most of the nation’s existing school-choice initiatives are limited to certain students based on eligibility categories such as income or special needs. Arizona’s expanded program eliminates such distinctions by allowing all families to take most of the state portion of their children’s taxpayer-funded education dollars to the providers of their choosing. The funding—about $7,000 a student—will follow the child to an “education savings account” directed by his parents or guardians. The funds may be spent on any approved education expenditures, such as private-school tuition and fees, tutoring, instructional materials and curriculum...

Read the Full Editorial (https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=9f45652f71&e=55d4e2f84a)

** School Choice Blooms in the Desert
------------------------------------------------------------

** A bill in Arizona opens scholarship accounts to all students statewide.
------------------------------------------------------------
By Editorial Board

The school choice movement continues to gain support, and the latest breakthrough is legislation in Arizona that will expand the availability of education savings accounts for any K-12 student in the state who wants one.

Arizona was the first state to create an education savings account (ESA) program in 2011. But only some students can apply—such as those with disabilities, in low-performing schools, or who reside on an Indian reservation.

The new bill allows any of the state’s more than a million K-12 students to be eligible for more than $6,000 for education expenses, including private school tuition and curricular materials. Most other state programs cap the number of students, set income eligibility requirements, or require students to be enrolled in public schools to apply. Arizona’s program may be the nation’s broadest.

The bill also expands the use of ESA funds for transportation and such equipment as computers or other education technology. The scholarship money is funded by the state and equal to 90% of what the state would provide for charter-school students. It will follow students to the schools of their choice—private, charter, or traditional union-dominated district schools.

“Arizona has long been a pioneer in education choice. Now, with this historic expansion of ESAs, we’ll continue to charter the path for others to follow suit,” tweeted Republican Gov. Doug Ducey, who has promoted school choice during his two terms and is expected to sign the legislation...

clean_body: Two editorials you can't miss about Arizona's new school choice legislation Hello, Arizona has blazed the trail with educational choice from open enrollment, to charter schools, and now universal Education Savings Accounts available to every K-12 student. There are not one, but two, editorials in the Wall Street Journal about how Arizona is leading other states. Both are worth your time to read. Can the GOP Become the Parents’ Party? By passing a historic school-choice bill, Arizona Republicans say yes. By Corey DeAngelis Republicans across the country are calling themselves the Parents’ Party. Republicans in Arizona just proved they’re worthy of the name. During his State of the State address in January, Arizona Republican Gov. Doug Ducey told the Legislature: “This session, let’s expand school choice any way we can. . . . Send me the bills, and I’ll sign them.” Republican lawmakers were listening. Last week, on two party-line votes, the Arizona House and Senate passed a monumental school-choice bill, which will soon be delivered to the governor’s desk. The state’s efforts come after what many have called the year of school choice. After months of power-hungry teachers’ unions fighting for school closings and political indoctrination in the classroom in 2021, 18 states chose to enact or expand programs to fund students instead of systems. Arizona just one-upped all of them. Most of the nation’s existing school-choice initiatives are limited to certain students based on eligibility categories such as income or special needs. Arizona’s expanded program eliminates such distinctions by allowing all families to take most of the state portion of their children’s taxpayer-funded education dollars to the providers of their choosing. The funding—about $7,000 a student—will follow the child to an “education savings account” directed by his parents or guardians. The funds may be spent on any approved education expenditures, such as private-school tuition and fees, tutoring, instructional materials and curriculum... Read the Full Editorial () School Choice Blooms in the Desert A bill in Arizona opens scholarship accounts to all students statewide. By Editorial Board The school choice movement continues to gain support, and the latest breakthrough is legislation in Arizona that will expand the availability of education savings accounts for any K-12 student in the state who wants one. Arizona was the first state to create an education savings account (ESA) program in 2011. But only some students can apply—such as those with disabilities, in low-performing schools, or who reside on an Indian reservation. The new bill allows any of the state’s more than a million K-12 students to be eligible for more than $6,000 for education expenses, including private school tuition and curricular materials. Most other state programs cap the number of students, set income eligibility requirements, or require students to be enrolled in public schools to apply. Arizona’s program may be the nation’s broadest. The bill also expands the use of ESA funds for transportation and such equipment as computers or other education technology. The scholarship money is funded by the state and equal to 90% of what the state would provide for charter-school students. It will follow students to the schools of their choice—private, charter, or traditional union-dominated district schools. “Arizona has long been a pioneer in education choice. Now, with this historic expansion of ESAs, we’ll continue to charter the path for others to follow suit,” tweeted Republican Gov. Doug Ducey, who has promoted school choice during his two terms and is expected to sign the legislation... Read the Full Editorial () Please help us get the word out! Yet again, Jerry Moran failed to act in the best interest of Kansans: Last week, he came down on the wrong side of history by voting NO on common-sense gun reform legislation.

The bipartisan gun control package, which garnered broad support on both sides of the aisle, makes great strides in protecting our children and families from senseless gun violence. _**But Moran chose to side with big money and the NRA over you and your loved ones.**_

[**As your future U.S. Senator, I’ll be sure to represent you and your family’s best interests and never put corporate special interests ahead of Kansan families. If you’re ready for real representation in Washington, donate to my campaign today >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47118748/353126562/183233180?refcode=MH_EM_FR_3MO_220628_2_3&refcode2=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjdlN2ZlZC00MWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5tWv2azbbXaczv2Kf8x2Ukyc0J5gwBEW8OBDR369B4s=)

As a father, every day I feel the responsibility of keeping our children safe. As a pastor, I have seen how senseless gun violence can test our faith. As a former mayor, I have witnessed the everyday gun violence that may not capture the media’s attention, but must end. body:
I’m reaching out to personally ask you to support my friend and North Carolina’s next senator, Cheri Beasley.
#

Hey there, it’s Cory. I’m reaching out to personally ask you to support my friend and North Carolina’s next senator, Cheri Beasley.
Her first FEC deadline of the general election is just two days away, and [**a donation of any amount you can spare would go a long way toward making up some ground for her campaign’s fundraising goal.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-june22.-3KU-G&refcode=em220628-2-ma&t=1&akid=1138%2E357359%2EE7ELrd)
This race is personal to me. My dad grew up in Hendersonville in the western North Carolina mountains. It’s the kind of place that a lot of politicians ignore or leave behind — but not Cheri. She shows up, listens, and fights to make sure everyone is heard, no matter their ZIP code.
She’s the kind of candidate who inspires me and gives me hope. Throughout her life, she has fiercely fought for justice and put the people first.
I know how much good we can accomplish for our families if we flip this open seat in North Carolina. Not only can Cheri do it, but when she does, I know she will be a fierce ally for working people and justice in the Senate — someone unafraid to stand up to the special interests, end the filibuster, and cast the decisive 51st vote for progress and change.
The polling consistently shows her in a statistical tie with her opponent, but she needs us to step up and have her back before her critical FEC deadline.
[**Please make a $3 donation to Cheri’s campaign to help her reach her goal before the FEC deadline. Every donation puts us one step closer to a historic victory in November — electing North Carolina’s first Black senator and the third Black woman elected to the U.S. Senate period.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-june22.-3KU-G&refcode=em220628-2-ma&t=2&akid=1138%2E357359%2EE7ELrd)
