We wanted to make sure you saw our plan to fight for abortion. | | | Peter, WFP’s Nelini Stamp talked to the the _Washington Post_ yesterday about what we want to see from our leaders at this moment in history: _“It’s really important right now that [Democrats] show they’re fighting for people, so people have a reason to go vote for them in November. The goodwill of voters is not going to last that long....**People don’t want to hear, ‘Vote for Democrats.’ They want to hear what folks are going to do.”**_ **[We’ve got plans to turn our rage into action — on the streets and at the ballot box, too. Chip in $3 or any amount to help us reach our $420,000 online end-of-quarter goal so we can elect more pro-choice champions. We’re just $18,000 away right now, and every dollar helps power our organizing in key races.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYU9EiEMtvdSchiMOIXrRFQv0RCnavBoNMLkTNWi9IM2FfefrnAhbJacePHBj_5lFPtzkw9IMF_CBvOdDNpzBayEAtQlF7kpj89su7vIJHcgrDylRmVedEv9bveB4BUSpgRnatyU80-eN3rkPri37BsvPnAo1E6vl5bsboXeglwgG7NFh6y4A4BQPuNZk71RuiqPEG6UNPeISYIYVjgpj3Zvs9iPuJ9ZlDVOx68tVZz_Qvd0dfvqn-bQZQnTwCcLckbU7f2eS-O9XWdd4NAOFmf2m3P9sqEhJNrzIw_K1LX5PlqowwpzDm7-Bd2-mSmCPVz2E220c_LcIVY41PV8R7LIFL-FgGGNaCl05BwsqYD6Fs/3na/zQ83L5MGQRapMs2TaO_u1w/h0/mZdphJ3s-MLcmr19PlH75qowYJWkHIk24hlokM9l8VE)** (And if you missed it, read our email from yesterday below to learn more about our strategy to defend abortion rights.) In solidarity, All of us at the Working Families Party \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Working Families Party
Date: Mon, June 27, 2022
Subject: Why we won’t ever tell you to “just vote” Peter,
The extreme right wing spent 50 years pushing to end abortion rights. They may think the fight is now over. clean_body: Democrats have to win races like Hillary’s if we are going to have a chance at holding onto the Majority. | = | You’ve heard it before — Democrats are holding onto a razor-thin majority in Congress, and redistricting has made it tougher for Democrats to win in many states. Luckily, there are a few exceptions — In Michigan's 3rd Congressional district, redistricting has actually given Democrats a better chance to win. On top of that, we also have an awesome candidate in Hillary Scholten, who has the experience, vision, and drive to flip this seat from Red to Blue. = | = | = Her team is facing a major FEC public fundraising deadline at the end of this month. Kevin McCarthy’s super PAC has already pledged to spend $2.2 million in this competitive district. We are going to have to keep up. Democrats have to win races like Hillary’s if we are going to have a chance at holding onto the Majority. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, = – Paul Begala * | | = Hillary Scholten for Congress Hillary Scholten for Congress PO Box 6233 Grand Rapids, MI 49516 United States | =

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

One of the reasons why I love calling the grassroots supporters who power
this campaign is to hear your stories. In my most recent calls, I have
heard your stories about standing up for civil rights, for the right to
vote, for reproductive rights and more. I have spoken with folks from
across Georgia. And I have had the chance to say thank you, directly, for
all that you do for my campaign and in your communities.

Our work — to fire a dangerous, extremist governor and begin building One
Georgia — will not be easy. But it is necessary, and I want to take the
time to personally thank you for being a part of this team.

That is why I am calling our grassroots supporters once again.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1472?refcode=sa_em_220628_B2_calls_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=789%2E1862389%2EDarDCq ]Can you chip in $25, or even $5 before our
June 30 fundraising deadline? Any amount — no matter how big or small —
gives us a chance to talk over the phone.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1472?refcode=sa_em_220628_B2_calls_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=789%2E1862389%2EDarDCq ]Stacey Abrams making a phone call with the caption 'Hi, may I speak to Jan'

Derek, my name
may be on the ballot — but this campaign is not about me. It’s about your
story, your family’s story and the stories of millions of Georgians across
the state who Brian Kemp has left behind.

Especially after the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, it is so easy
to feel helpless — but it is vital to remember that we are not alone. To
believe in our ability to protect one another. To lean into our capacity
to defend our rights in the streets and at the ballot box.

I’m making these calls because this grassroots team is the backbone of our
campaign,
Derek. And I want you to hear
from me directly that together, if we unite, good will be won.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1472?refcode=sa_em_220628_B2_calls_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=789%2E1862389%2EDarDCq ]I’d love the chance to speak with you,
Derek. Make your
first
$5 donation before our June 30 fundraising deadline — and
you could end up on my call list soon.

Let's get it done,

Stacey

| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

So, here we are once again, **five months until Election Day,** and if we learned anything from the Supreme Court leak last week, the entire political landscape can be changed by a single event.

Thank you for your support, Patty Murray |

body:
👏👏👏 | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/efa1328f28bc/only-4-months-away?e=20ac8f046f)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Peter, As we watch the recent events unfolding in our nation, it is becoming more obvious how critical it is to have leaders who love God, people, and life. The polarization of so many political issues has disunified our country, and we are left with brokenness and strife.

We have seen where such easy access to our phones and the news has created the illusion that we know all the facts. We see where social media gives the perception that most individuals and families "have it together" when the truth is contrary. It is important that we as Americans stick to the values that make us who we are, but we also need to listen and show love to our neighbors as God teaches us.

I thought I would drop a funny, "behind the scenes," picture from our previous outreach event. You get to see the disorganized chaos of our group trying to take a photo, but that group got to demonstrate kindness to kids that day, and I hope we can spread that kindness throughout our community and grow a safer, more unified district in the future.
---
|
---
| We are coming up on four months out from the general election for 2022. I need your help to accomplish the mission for the fight for **truth** , **justice** , and **unity** in America. To win this Congressional seat, it is going to take a lot of funds and a lot of "boots on the ground." We have just begun the goal to have **1,000** people start a **$22** recurring monthly gift starting now through November (hint this is $110 in 5 months per donor if you start NOW in June). If you are able to start one of these recurring gifts (or more if you are so inclined), please click the donate button below!

---

------------------------------------------------------------
Dominic Rapini: "Election Reform Leader"

Dear ,

Last week, Dominic’s message of fighting for common-sense Voter ID laws and giving our election officials the tools they need to succeed in their jobs started making its way across the radio waves in Connecticut.
Listen to Dominic’s Radio Ad Here! (https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=37a794e598&e=8763c56857)

Here is the script from the ad:

Distrust in our elections threatens to tear down our Republic while politicians refuse to take action.

Not Dominic Rapini.

A lifelong businessman, Dominic Rapini never settles for a bad deal.

That’s why Rapini will lead the fight for common-sense Voter IDs laws.

And he’ll give election officials the tools to keep our voter rolls updated, accurate, and in accordance with the highest standards of data integrity.

Be sure to tune into your local radio station to listen to it live!

I look forward to seeing you on the campaign trail!
Dominic Rapini

Dominic Rapini

Republican Candidate for Secretary of the State

| Tonight, Colorado constituents in CD7 voted to advance Congressional Candidate Erik Aadland to the general election in November.

| "I am thrilled and humbled by this hard-won success," stated Aadland. "So much of this victory goes to my extraordinary team, who has worked tirelessly for over a year to spread our message of strength, unity, and virtue throughout CD7. I am eternally grateful to my wife Megan, and our three amazing kids, for standing by me each step of the way." "I commend my Republican colleagues, Tim Reichert and Laurel Imer, for fighting to the finish, never quitting, making this a very difficult contest. It was an honor to be in the arena with them." "Now, I am ready to face Brittney Petterson in the general election and prove that Coloradans do not want the radical ideologies she is trying to force upon us. The wind is at our backs, and I am confident voters will choose me to be their champion in November, to represent them honorably in DC."

## A brief bio of Erik Aadland
---
| |
---
| Erik Aadland was born into a patriotic Army family as the son of Major General (Ret) Anders and Sandra Aadland. Moving over 21 times, Aadland graduated from High School in Heidelberg, Germany, then went on to attend the United States Military Academy at West Point, NY. Graduating in 2002 not long after 9/11, Aadland was commissioned an Army officer and served with combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, during which he received two Bronze Stars (one for valor).
Aadland left the Army as a Captain in 2011 to pursue a career in the Oil and Natural Gas industry, which culminated in a position as a Project Manager managing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. After leaving his company in 2020, Aadland finished his master's degree in Depth Psychology from Pacifica Graduate Institute. While working to become a counselor to help veterans and trauma victims, Aadland recognized that radical Progressive policies were harming everyday Coloradans, endangering their freedoms and imperiling his children's future, which eventually resulted in him entering the political arena. With the country's future imperiled by a corrupt establishment, Aadland once again feels called to honor his oath to defend the US Constitution by running for Congress, committed to putting Colorado and her people first. Aadland's proudest accomplishment is his marriage of 15 years, out of which he has three children. He currently resides in the front range of the Colorado Rocky Mountains.

clean_body: | | | | | | Tonight, Colorado constituents in CD7 voted to advance Congressional Candidate Erik Aadland to the general election in November. | | "I am thrilled and humbled by this hard-won success," stated Aadland. "So much of this victory goes to my extraordinary team, who has worked tirelessly for over a year to spread our message of strength, unity, and virtue throughout CD7. I am eternally grateful to my wife Megan, and our three amazing kids, for standing by me each step of the way." "I commend my Republican colleagues, Tim Reichert and Laurel Imer, for fighting to the finish, never quitting, making this a very difficult contest. It was an honor to be in the arena with them." "Now, I am ready to face Brittney Petterson in the general election and prove that Coloradans do not want the radical ideologies she is trying to force upon us. The wind is at our backs, and I am confident voters will choose me to be their champion in November, to represent them honorably in DC." | | | | | A brief bio of Erik Aadland | | | Erik Aadland was born into a patriotic Army family as the son of Major General (Ret) Anders and Sandra Aadland. Moving over 21 times, Aadland graduated from High School in Heidelberg, Germany, then went on to attend the United States Military Academy at West Point, NY. Graduating in 2002 not long after 9/11, Aadland was commissioned an Army officer and served with combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, during which he received two Bronze Stars (one for valor). Aadland left the Army as a Captain in 2011 to pursue a career in the Oil and Natural Gas industry, which culminated in a position as a Project Manager managing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. After leaving his company in 2020, Aadland finished his master's degree in Depth Psychology from Pacifica Graduate Institute. While working to become a counselor to help veterans and trauma victims, Aadland recognized that radical Progressive policies were harming everyday Coloradans, endangering their freedoms and imperiling his children's future, which eventually resulted in him entering the political arena. With the country's future imperiled by a corrupt establishment, Aadland once again feels called to honor his oath to defend the US Constitution by running for Congress, committed to putting Colorado and her people first. Aadland's proudest accomplishment is his marriage of 15 years, out of which he has three children. Here’s the cold, hard truth:
1. Laura Kelly’s Kansas ranks as the third-worst state in the country for tax burden on retirees and is in the least tax-friendly category for retirees because of the combined burden of high income, sales, and property taxes.

2. Kansas is one of only 13 states that tax Social Security retirement through its state income tax.

3. The Laura Kelly administration has recommended increasing income taxes on retirees and other Kansans who earn more than $50,000 per year.

4. In 2021, Kansas was one of only 17 states in the country that started the new decade with net population loss. Kansas finished the prior decade with its slowest population growth since the 1930s.

We MUST - and can - do better! That’s why I’ve proposed **RETIRE TAX FREE**. Retire Tax Free would provide relief to retirees living on fixed incomes and struggling with both the rising everyday costs of inflation and shrinking retirement investments because of market losses. The plan is also an important first step toward the urgent need to grow Kansas by encouraging more retirees of all income levels to remain in Kansas, or move to Kansas, rather than move to other states. I’m asking you to help me share this information so we can do something truly amazing for our state, and help a lot of Kansans along the way.

body:
My opponent in one of the most hotly contested congressional races of the cycle won her DEM primary by a mere 35 votes. If that doesn't tell you how c | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=ddd6674e32034acb92e929125f1de15e&_e=xbG_L5TvAFtMTgWHY8nG3qqR8RXHwzqa3Ywa4GN6KFa4Lzs5ZrNOwt-nsdfHon0WfSkmaFiY5IQzCHlZTBxhb2fOK6KtHFQBfceMyejjnd6B9sfJUAJaSHUO5o5HRkBQMmtXWTVFApkaaTrcVJ_6mKE1AJAjF_Ybut3hNoJ8QEdisvj7aZktFCjOSEKSElnBpBTjPXCOuOw3ACzuW35_b8LhnN4AUtJyMloQ2S4C_t_ZCS0RMBUwOc_jFTytBYkIJPEHEjT2Elx992Gx_wdib6a-QSG9yZFYoSI4DWrAb7jq3o6aS538JYUj2VGu12hfggEoYr0oN4nkEKHEUp39u3iuF05hMUtQtVA-nYrV9JJe5zQTiotlF1p9EY19R8ZDQKnmhOhdHeC9G7uSB9ajo8I63Ev14prDJwStrfj6N5ktA4qxPPZScGkCtVLZNleDQNLapf7GwPTiAvGGyx7ptw%3D%3D)
---
Fellow American,

**First:** Two weeks ago, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time, sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has **NEVER elected a Republican** to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to 1903. ** **

**Now:** I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes.

I spent the day door knocking in the Florida heat today and temperatures reached a blistering 100 degrees!

But as they say, hard work pays off!

[Help me close out the fundraising quarter strong by supporting my campaign today!](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/j8umLIse0EVOuIM5bZ3WNg/kNoYZPn0892l1YeYby2IERDw)

Most voters I speak with are stunned that they are speaking with an actual candidate, and they tell me that they have NEVER heard from any politicians directly.

My RINO opponent, Do-Nothing Dan Webster hasn't had an in-person Townhall meeting in recent memory . . . if at all.

What's that tell you?

He and the other career politicians who avoid speaking to the public **ARE AFRAID OF THE VOTERS!**

They're afraid of being called out for DOING NOTHING!

**They 're afraid of being put on the spot and being forced to give a straight answer!**

They're afraid that the public will see through the façade of power they work so hard to maintain and see that they have no idea how to get our nation back on track!

**I am not afraid!**

I'm speaking to voters every day. I'm holding Town Hall meetings NOW, as a candidate, and I will continue to do so even after I'm elected as the next Congresswoman.

I won't shy away from any questions, and if you know me, you know I will never walk on eggshells in the name of political correctness!

I'm going to Washington to work, and to fight, [but I need your help to get there.](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/j8umLIse0EVOuIM5bZ3WNg/kNoYZPn0892l1YeYby2IERDw)

We have three days left until the end of the fundraising quarter and we have to put up BIG numbers to win. **[Please donate as much as you can today, before it's too late!](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/j8umLIse0EVOuIM5bZ3WNg/kNoYZPn0892l1YeYby2IERDw) And in the meantime . . . I'll keep knocking on these doors.**

Thank you for all that you do.

Respectfully,

---
| | | Police Captain and U.S. Army Infantry veteran Keith Swank here.

As a police officer I've been shot at, spit on, punched, kicked and stabbed while fulfilling my duty to protect the public.

After facing down and arresting some of the most dangerous criminals in the country as a police officer, I've got no problem saying "no" to lobbyists and special interests in Washington, DC.

As a cop on the street, I could call for backup if I was ever in need of help.

**_Unfortunately, many of our elected "leaders" have been turning their backs on us and the country. We have to rely on each other._**

**You're my backup now.**
---
| [DONATE](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=5a009a00f1&e=d32193ab14 "Anedot Donate Link")
---
| Democrat DA's and judges won't prosecute criminals or hold them on bail, and the Biden administration is encouraging it—along with human trafficking and drug cartels that want to control our border.

**China and Mexican cartels are now killing over 100,000 people a year** in the US with illegal drugs like Fentanyl.

**_Under Biden and Pelosi crime is at an all-time high; sky high inflation and the cost of gas are making our country poorer. _**

I've had enough. **_We can't stand by anymore and let this happen._**

They're coming after conservatives for political dissent, while at the same time Antifa terrorists get off with light sentences— _or completely free._

This is all very dangerous and wrong. And it's why I'm running.

**_As a policeman and U.S. Army Infantry soldier I took an oath, to protect our country and the constitution and lay down my life if I had to_ \--**defending our country against ALL enemies, foreign or domestic.

Those oath's I took never expire. And I'd be honored to take a third one, and **[go to fight for you in DC.](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=4cf48563e7&e=d32193ab14 "DONATE LINK")**

Leftist groups funded by the likes of George Soros are going to try and turn voters against me with lies and intimidation tactics. The D.C. establishment isn't helping me either. They'll fight against us to make sure my opponent and her leftist friends stay in power.

It's time to hit back. _But in order to do so, I need the critical resources it takes to take on the DC establishment and win._** That's why I'm asking for your help.** **[Will you help me fight back with a donation of $15 or more today?](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=842e2e098a&e=d32193ab14 "DONATE LINK")**

**In Freedom, **

**Keith R. Swank |[KeithSwank.com](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=7cc7bc2270&e=d32193ab14 "https://keithswank.com/about.html")
GOP Candidate for Congress | Police Captain | U.S. Army Infantry Veteran**

**PS:** _**My opponent, a former lobbyist and freshmen member of Congress votes 100% percent of the time with Nancy Pelosi. That's unacceptable.**_ She even got Pelosi to our district for the first time to "brag" about their shameful record. It's time we kick both of them out and get some work done saving the country.

**PPS:** I believe you deserve to have your rights and safety protected as much as the "elites" that influence our political system. **_I swore an oath to protect this country in the U.S. Army and as a cop on the street; I'll do it again for you in Congress. We can't lose this year. The country is on the line. Let's get started. _**
---
| [DONATE](https://keithswank.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7d993252d065453f0295f0cc&id=2b8e26738b&e=d32193ab14 "DONATE")
---
| | **ABOUT: **Keith Swank is a U.S. Army Infantry veteran and Seattle Police Captain sought after for his expertise as an instructor in crisis intervention and de-escalation. He served as Night Duty Commander and Commander of the Metro Special Response Section (S.W.A.T. Team, Harbor Patrol, Canine Unit and Arson/Bomb Squad). In the U.S. Army he served in a long range reconnaissance unit and graduated from Ranger School, Airborne School, High Altitude Low Opening (HALO) and Infantry Training. Swank is a graduate of the University of Washington where he attained a degree in psychology. He is endorsed by the Pierce County and Thurston County Republican Party.

| It may not be the most dramatic or sensational part of politics, but it definitely is one of the most important.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=432%2E5257348%2Eg6kZBq)
Hey Derek, got a moment for a quick update? It’s a really busy time of year for candidates — and I’m sure it is for you too — but thankfully, I was able to carve out a few minutes of my schedule today to write this email.
We’re nearing the tail end of the last week of the FEC quarter, where federal campaigns must publicly report their fundraising efforts. At the beginning of each quarter, I talk with my team and set a goal on the number we need to raise in order to fend off GOP attacks, protect our House Majority and expand it.
It may not be the most dramatic or sensational part of politics, but it definitely is one of the most important. Making sure we have the resources needed to reach out to voters, cut through the Republican misinformation campaigns, and get our campaign’s core message out through the grassroots is so critical to our success.
Without the proper tools, winning battleground elections and defending our majority becomes an extremely tough uphill battle — especially considering the millions that dark money Super PACs are spending to elect right-wing candidates across the country.
As I said, this isn’t something you’d see plastered over the news headlines, which is why I’m personally reaching out now.

subject: This Supreme Court and Republicans in Congress will not stop here

body:
I will continue organizing and fighting to protect abortion rights, in Seattle and across the country, and I will continue supporting progressive candidates who are with me in this fight.
#
Peter, there are things we can do right now to protect abortion rights and we can’t wait.
I’m calling on the White House to take urgent executive action to protect abortion access in America — and I won’t stop fighting for action. I’m again urging the Senate to abolish the filibuster and codify _Roe v. Wade_ in federal law by passing the Women’s Health Protection Act.
And I’m making it clear: the House Judiciary Committee must hold hearings on Supreme Court Justices who testified under oath, in front of Congress, that _Roe_ was settled precedent, then voted to overturn _Roe_.
I will continue organizing and fighting to protect abortion rights, in Seattle and across the country, and I will continue supporting progressive candidates who are with me in this fight. [**Your donation allows us to do this critical organizing and advocacy work — all to build a fairer, more just America. If you’re able, can you make a contribution to my campaign right now?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14447?refcode=em20220628-1379&t=1&akid=1379%2E420207%2E_8dd7K)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14447?refcode=em20220628-1379&t=20&akid=1379%2E420207%2E_8dd7K)**
As one of the one in four women in this country who has had an abortion, I am outraged for what this will mean for those who need abortion care — particularly those who will be most harmed by this decision: Black and Brown women, those who live in rural areas or have lower incomes and can’t afford to cross state lines for care, young people and LGBTQ people, and women in abusive relationships.
This Supreme Court and Republicans in Congress will not stop here — same-sex and interracial marriage, LGBTQ+ rights, the right to contraception, and more could very well be next. And if we don’t take decisive action to protect abortion rights NOW, the right-wing will only be emboldened to continue trying to take away our rights.
**We cannot allow the Supreme Court overturning _Roe v. Wade_ to go unanswered. We must take action, and that’s why I’m calling on my colleagues in Congress and the White House to act NOW.**
[**If you can, please contribute to my campaign before the end-of-quarter deadline on June 30. We’re preparing for a summer of action and need your support in this fight.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14447?refcode=em20220628-1379&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1379%2E420207%2E_8dd7K)
Thank you for being by my side in this fight.
In solidarity,
Pramila

clean_body: I will continue organizing and fighting to protect abortion rights, in Seattle and across the country, and I will continue supporting progressive candidates who are with me in this fight. Peter, there are things we can do right now to protect abortion rights and we can’t wait. I’m calling on the White House to take urgent executive action to protect abortion access in America — and I won’t stop fighting for action. I’m again urging the Senate to abolish the filibuster and codify Roe v. Wade in federal law by passing the Women’s Health Protection Act. And I’m making it clear: the House Judiciary Committee must hold hearings on Supreme Court Justices who testified under oath, in front of Congress, that Roe was settled precedent, then voted to overturn Roe. I will continue organizing and fighting to protect abortion rights, in Seattle and across the country, and I will continue supporting progressive candidates who are with me in this fight. As one of the one in four women in this country who has had an abortion, I am outraged for what this will mean for those who need abortion care — particularly those who will be most harmed by this decision: Black and Brown women, those who live in rural areas or have lower incomes and can’t afford to cross state lines for care, young people and LGBTQ people, and women in abusive relationships. This Supreme Court and Republicans in Congress will not stop here — same-sex and interracial marriage, LGBTQ+ rights, the right to contraception, and more could very well be next. And if we don’t take decisive action to protect abortion rights NOW, the right-wing will only be emboldened to continue trying to take away our rights. We cannot allow the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade to go unanswered. We must take action, and that’s why I’m calling on my colleagues in Congress and the White House to act NOW. Thank you for being by my side in this fight. In solidarity, Pramila | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com
